Timpuri/Kirvesmies Turkuun!

Etsimme nyt asiakkaillemme timpureita/kirvesmiehiä Varsinais-Suomeen eri työmaille. Meillä on tarjolla erilaisia tehtäviä, ja autamme sinua löytämään osaamiseesi sopivan pestin. Löytyy kerrostalotyömaita, saneerauskohteita, toimitilamuutoksia. Tule kertomaan oma osaamisalueesi niin me etsimme sinulle työn!! Vapaita työtehtäviä löytyy per heti hyville tekijöille.

Oletko sinä rakennusalan kokenut konkari ja haet uusia mahdollisuuksia niin uudisrakentamisen, kuin myös saneerausrakentamisen puolelta? Mikäli vaihtelevat työkohteet ja kilpailukykyinen palkkaus kiinnostaa 17-21 €/h , laitathan hakemusta tulemaan ja jutellaan lisää.

Odotamme hakijoilta:

* Aikaisempaa laajaa kokemusta rakennusalasta.

* Hyvää asennetta.

* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia.

* Omat työkalut katsotaan hakemuksessa eduksi ja niistä maksetaan asianmukainen korvaus.

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on myös plussaa.

Tuu rakentaa parempaa Turkua yks naula kerrallaan!

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan.

* Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet

* Apua työssä tarvittavien korttien hankinnassa

Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa.

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

jobs.title: Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattilaisia keikkatyöhön Mehiläisen Lapsiperhepalveluihin Länsi-Uudellemaalle, Mehiläinen Kotihoito
jobs.description:
Meitä mehiläisiäon jo lähes 50 000 eikä kahta samanlaista. Yksi asia kuitenkin yhdistää meitä kaikkia - meillä on elämä tehtävänä. Jos tunnet samoin, tule meille töihin.

Haemme Länsi-Uudellemaalle sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaisia keikkatyösuhteisiin lapsiperhepalveluihin Kotipalvelu Mehiläiseen.

Mitä on lapsiperheiden kotipalvelut?
Lapsiperheiden kotipalvelun hoitaja huolehtii lapsista yhdessä lasten vanhempien kanssa, ohjaa kasvatuksessa sekä tukee vanhemmuudessa, arkirutiinien hallinnassa ja perheen toimintakyvyn parantamisessa muuttuvissa elämäntilanteissa. Asiakkaamme ovat perheitä, joille on erinäisistä syistä myönnetty lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu oman arjen tueksi. Kotipalvelun työntekijät auttavat lastenhoidossa, kasvatuksessa ja perheen omien voimavarojen vahvistamisessa sekä tarvittaessa kodinhoidossa yhdessä vanhemman kanssa. Palvelutarve keskittyy arkipäiviin, arki-iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin. Työ on usein vapaa-ajantoiminnassa ohjaamista ja arjen perustoiminnoista huolehtimista. Työssä pääset oppimaan uutta ja saat keskittyä yhden asiakasperheen lasten hoitoon koko vuoron ajan.

Etsimme nyt erityisesti hoitajia, joilla on osaamista työskennellä asiakasperheissä, joissa lapsilla on erilaisia erityisen tuen tarpeita. Lapsilla saattaa olla esimerkiksi aivovamma, cp-vamma, erilaisia lihas- tai neurologisia sairauksia, tapaturman jälkitiloja, neuropsykiatrinen häiriöitä ja niin edes päin. Tästä syystä edellytämme kokemusta erityistä tukea tarvitsevien lasten kanssa työskentelystä.

Työ lapsiperheiden kotipalveluissa on kaksivuorotyötä pääasiassa klo 8-21 välillä. Voimme sopia vaihtelevista työtunneista toiveidesi mukaan. Haluamme, että henkilöstömme työ ja vapaa-aika ovat tasapainossa. Järjestämme myös yksilölliset ja kattavat perehdytykset tekijän osaamistason mukaan. Pyrimme mahdollistamaan käynnit tuttujen asiakkaiden luona ja panostamme asiakkaiden kiireettömään kohtaamiseen. Haluamme, että hoitajamme saavat tehdä työnsä rauhassa panostaen hyvään hoitoon ja palveluun.

Olemme jatkuvasti kehittyvä ja työntekijöitämme arvostava työnantaja. Hyvä esihenkilötyö on työntekijöiden viihtyvyyden avain ja olemme työnantajana sitoutuneet kouluttamaan esihenkilöitämme aktiivisesti. Meillä asiakkaat aidosti arvostavat työtäsi ja antavat positiivista palautetta päivittäin. Mehiläinen Kotipalveluiden suositteluindeksi(NPS)on 60 asteikolla -100 - +100. Työntekijämme pitävät meitä erittäin joustava työnantaja ja pyrimme aina mahdollistamaan työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainon. Isona työnantajana haluamme tarjota eri ammattiryhmille ammatillisia kasvumahdollisuuksia ja urapolkuja Mehiläisen sisällä.

Odotamme sinulta:
Sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutusta. Emme valitettavasti pysty tarjoamaan töitä alan opiskelijoille.

Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa (vähintään tasoa B2).

Valmiutta kohdata asiakkaasi iloisella ja positiivisella asenteella.

Vähintään vuoden työkokemusta lapsien ja / tai vauvojen kanssa työskentelystä.

Kokemusta kehitysvammaisten parissa työskentelystä.


Katsomme eduksi:
Voimassa olevat LOVe- lääkeluvat.

Monikielisyyden.

Osaamisen erityislapsista, esimerkiksi nepsy-osaaminen.

Katsomme eduksi osaamisen vaihtoehtoisien kommunikaatiomenetelmien käytöstä, kuten tukikuvista ja tukiviittomista.


Tutustu lisää työyhteisöömme Instagramissa ja Facebookissa: @mehilainenkotipalvelut

Palkkaus: Meillä on käytössä yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaluokkaG20C, keikkatyösuhteissa lisäksi + 9% lomakorvaus.

Tehtävään valittavien on esitettävä lain edellyttämä rikosrekisteriote. Tehtävässä edellytetään Tartuntatautilain 55§:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystäkaikilta, jotka täyttävät THL:n riskikriteerit.

Miten haku etenee?
1. Jätäthän hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian.Aloitamme haastattelut yleensä jo hakuaikana.
2.Sinut kutsutaan haastatteluun sähköpostilla tai soittamalla, joten seuraa sähköpostiasi ja pidä puhelin ulottuvillasi.
3.Teemme viimeiset rekrytointipäätökset työpaikkailmoituksen sulkeuduttua ja ilmoitamme päätöksistä hakijoille noin parin viikon kuluessa.
4. Toiveenamme on, että uudet työntekijämme pääsevät aloittamaan työnsä mahdollisimman pian valintojen jälkeen.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:
Minna Sala
minna.sala@mehilainen.fi

Me mehiläiset rakennamme yhdessä parasta paikkaa ammattilaiselle. Teemme sen johtamalla reilusti ja suhtautumalla laatuun tinkimättömästi. Saamme asioita aikaiseksi toimivassa työympäristössä, jossa tukena on osaavia ja välittäviä työkavereita. Kasvamme ja kehitymme yhdessä. Olemme paras paikka ammattilaiselle, jolla on elämä tehtävänä.

jobs.title: Wärtsilä: Development Specialist / Manager (Supply Chain data)
jobs.description:
**Type:** Full-time - Fixed term, 12 months

**Location:** Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku

**Application deadline**: 20.9.2026

Interested in using data to improve supply chain processes? Join Wärtsilä Energy to develop reporting, data solutions and smarter ways of working across supply chain management.

**Key responsibilities**

In this position, your focus will be on developing more data-driven ways of working within Wärtsilä Energys Supply Chain Management organisation, particularly in procurement and strategic sourcing. You will work hands-on with data and Power BI, develop reports and data products, define KPIs and help improve how supply chain data is structured and used.

You will work closely with supply chain professionals and data specialists to develop ideas further and turn business needs into practical data solutions. You will coordinate development projects and explore how new tools, including AI and intelligent agents, could support supply chain processes. You will be supported by Wärtsiläs data experts on more technically demanding topics, but you are also expected to be a hands-on contributor who develops solutions and drives improvements from idea to implementation.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You are a proactive and curious person who enjoys working with data, learning new topics and finding better ways of doing things. You are comfortable taking ownership, bringing structure to development work and moving things forward independently. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and are willing to test and learn when working with new tools and topics. You are also comfortable coordinating projects and keeping development work moving forward in collaboration with others.

**What we are looking for:**

- Several years of experience in project coordination or development work

- A relevant academic background in engineering, supply chain, business or a similar field, combined with an understanding of supply chain processes

- Hands-on experience with data, reporting and Power BI

- A proactive, independent and analytical working style with the ability to structure information and drive improvements forward

- Good communication and collaboration skills in English


**Additionally valued:**

- Previous experience working with procurement, purchasing or strategic sourcing, as it will help you understand the business context and related data

- Experience with automation and AI solutions, intelligent agents or applying AI in a business environment

- Familiarity with SAP, Salesforce, Databricks or other ERP and data platforms

- Good skills in Finnish


**We can offer you:**

- Broad opportunities to build expertise by working with supply chain, procurement, data and digitalisation professionals

- Versatile responsibilities where you can develop new ways to use data across supply chain management and turn ideas into practical improvements

- A truly international working environment where you will get to collaborate with a variety of colleagues from different departments

- An opportunity to continue discussions of future employment before ending the 12-month period

- Good introduction to Wärtsiläs operations and processes, helping you understand development needs and contribute to meaningful improvements


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time, fixed-term position for 12 months, where you will join Wärtsilä Energy as aTalents employee. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible.

Your immediate team is split between Helsinki and Vaasa, but you can be based in Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku. Wärtsilä offers a flexible hybrid working model, and we hope you can work from the office regularly.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to lead and coordinate facility business operations across multiple sites in Sweden. The role is responsible for ensuring third party contracts, Channel Partners, Customer interaction and Commercial Contract Management.

The successful candidate will have strong operational leadership capabilities and experience managing operations in Sweden. Previous experience working with large-scale industrial facilities, manufacturing environments, infrastructure, or other complex multi-site operations will be considered a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

·      Lead and coordinate day-to-day facility management operations across multiple locations in Sweden.

·      Ensure facilities are operated safely, efficiently, reliably, and in accordance with agreed service levels and operational standards.

·      Establish consistent operating procedures, service standards, and governance across all locations.

·      Coordinate site managers, facility personnel, contractors, suppliers, and external service providers.

·      Monitor facility performance and ensure timely resolution of operational issues and service disruptions.

·      Manage relationships and performance of external contractors and service providers

·      Conduct or coordinate regular facility inspections, operational reviews, service assessments, and compliance checks.

·      Manage operational budgets and monitor facility-related expenditure, maintenance costs, supplier costs, and cost-saving initiatives.

·      Participate in procurement, supplier selection, contract negotiations, and service-level management.

Qualifications & Experience

·      Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification.

·      At least 3 years of experience as operations management,

·      Experience working within large-scale customers is highly desirable.

·      Experience managing contractors, suppliers, maintenance services, and operational teams.

·      Experience with operational budgets, cost control, procurement, and contract management.

·      Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving capabilities.

·      Ability to prioritize and manage multiple sites, operational issues, and improvement initiatives simultaneously.

·      Ability and willingness to travel regularly within Sweden.

·      Good command of English; Swedish language skills are an advantage.

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist hos NorSea Denmark
jobs.description:
Brænder du for digital marketing, content creation og lead-generering? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler i teamet!

Rolle og ansvarsområde

Som Marketing Specialist bliver du en vigtig del af vores kommunikations- og marketingteam. Du får ansvar for at planlægge, koordinere og gennemføre B2B-marketingaktiviteter, der understøtter forretningen og skaber synlige resultater.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med både marketingteamet og salgsorganisationen og omsætter planer og idéer til konkrete kampagner og aktiviteter.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil blandt andet være:

Understøtte salgsaktiviteter

Du får en central rolle i samarbejdet mellem salg og marketing, hvor du skal omsætte strategi til målrettede kampagner, der skaber relevante leads.

Du bliver ansvarlig for at koordinere og sikre fremdrift i projekter og løbende analysere og optimere effekten af vores indsats.

 

Digital marketing

Du får ansvar for digitale marketingindsatser som betalte annoncer på LinkedIn, Google Ads og nyhedsbreve. Du vil også være med til at skabe sammenhæng mellem organisk indhold, SEO/GEO og  landingpages.

Du skal løbende analysere data i G4A og Hubspot for at kunne forbedre kampagner og indhold.

 

Content creation

Med fokus på budskab, målgruppe og visuel formidling, skal du være med til at skabe content og storytelling til blandt andet sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, website, intern kommunikation, annoncer, salgsmateriale, kundecases, præsentationer, video og meget mere. 

 

Hvem er du?

  • Har en relevant uddannelse (/kurser)

  • Erfaring med digital marketing, content creation eller lignende rolle

  • Kendskab til CRM og account based marketing er et plus

  • Teknisk snilde og forståelse for systemer, ai etc.

  • Brænder for kommunikation og marketing

  • Selvstændig og struktureret

  • Gode skrivekundskaber på dansk og engelsk

  • Kendskab fotografering/video og efterbehandling i Adobe er et plus

 

Din profil:

Du vil opnå størst succes i rollen, hvis du som person er initiativrig, selvstændig og tager ejerskab for de ting, du gør. Du motiveres af at tænke nyt, lære nye ting og udvikle dig. 

Du trives med skiftende dage, hvor langsigtede og planlagte marketingsaktiviteter og rutineopgaver lever side om side med nyopståede idéer og behov, der skal findes kreative og effektive løsninger til, her og nu.

 

Vi tilbyder

En arbejdsplads med flad struktur, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling. Du bliver en del af et uformelt kommunikations- og marketingteam, der, hvis vi selv skal sige det, er 100-meter-mestre i hverdagshygge.

Vi tilbyder en alsidig rolle med frihed under ansvar og gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Hos os får du medansvar og medbestemmelse, og dine ansvarsområder kan udvikle sig i takt med dine kompetencer og interesser. Samtidig får du indblik i store og spændende projekter, hvor kommunikation og marketing spiller en vigtig rolle.

Om NorSea

NorSea Denmark er en B2B-servicevirksomhed i maritim-, logistik-, og energiindustrien. Vi er en del af NorSea Group, som er ejet af Wilhelmsen, der med 2200 lokationer er et af verdens største maritime selskaber.

Vi servicerer energiindustrien globalt gennem vores one-stop-shop-koncept, der blandt andet indeholder løsninger inden for logistik, mandskab, kontor/varehus, skibsagentur, og ikke mindst opererer vi på Danmarks største supply base og har gjort det i mere end 50 år.

Vi har hovedkontor i Esbjerg, men har kontorer flere steder i Danmark og internationalt.

Arbejdsmiljø og personalegoder

Vi tilbyder inspirerende kontorfaciliteter i House of Offshore Innovation, der sammen med vores 30+ lejere skaber et dynamisk og innovativt miljø. Hver dag sørger Meyers for frokost i kantinen, og der er adgang døgnet rundt til vores fitnesslokale, der er frit tilgængeligt for vores medarbejdere. Vi støtter lokal sport og kultur og laver jævnligt samarbejdsaftaler, der sikrer enten gratis eller gode personalerabatter i byens sportsklubber, butikker og restauranter.

Vi ved, hvor vigtigt det sociale er; derfor sørger vores aktivitetsudvalg for hyggelige medarbejderarrangementer. Unge til og med 35 kan desuden være med i NorSea Young Talents, der sikrer den bedste start på karrieren med lærerige og sociale arrangementer med jævnaldrende.

 

Interesseret?

Er det dig, vi leder efter? Så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning!

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Hanne Wind Johannsen, Communication & Marketing Manager på hanne.johannsen@norseagroup.com

jobs.title: Resepsjonist, Scandic Narvik, deltid
jobs.description:
VI HAR ROM FOR DEG
Resepsjonist som vil være der det skjer

Etter en lang dag på reise er det få ting som er mer hyggelig enn å møte et vennlig ansikt som ønsker deg varmt velkommen. Det gjør vi i resepsjonen på Scandic Narvik hver dag.

Resepsjonen er også hotellets naturlige møtepunkt, så du kommer til å være i sentrum av der det skjer. Vi vet ikke alltid hvilke utfordringer vi kan møte på under en arbeidsdag, men vi vet at når vi samkjører avdelingene på hotellet, så kommer alle til å slutte opp om våre gjesters ønskemål. Dette gjør vi sammen!.

**Dine arbeidsoppgaver som resepsjonist: **

  • Inn og utsjekking av våre gjester i vårt system Opera/Scorpio
  • Koordinere med alle avdelinger for å oppfylle våre gjesters ønsker og behov
  • Bidra til mer salg
  • Ta del i og aktivt arbeide med avdelingsmålene
  • Ta imot bookinger og hente fakturaer
  • Svare på spørsmål i fra våre gjester, både elektronisk og over skranke
  • Kassehåndtering

Vi har gode utviklingsmuligheter i vår organisasjon. Hvis du har ønske og ambisjoner om utvikling, vil du få mulighet til å vokse hos oss!

Erfaring og kvalifikasjoner som vi ønsker at du har og kan dele med oss:

  • Fagbrev som resepsjonist eller erfaring med lignende jobb innen servicebransjen
  • Snakker et av de skandinaviske språkene og engelsk flytende **Krav

Personlige egenskaper vi ser etter hos deg:

  • Kvalitetsbevisst med salg og service i ryggraden
  • Operativ, fleksibel og serviceinnstilt
  • Pålitelig
  • Evne til å takle høyt arbeidspress

Dette er en fast ansettelse i 45% stilling på deltid.

Stillingen består i hovedsak av ettermiddags- og kveldsvakter hver andre helg, men det må påregnes variasjoner i arbeidstid.

Oppstart etter nærmere avtale.


Vi verdsetter mangfold og inkludering på arbeidsplassen vår og er interessert i å lære mer om dine behov og eventuelle tilrettelegginger som kan støtte deg i å lykkes i denne rollen. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av funksjonsnivå eller bakgrunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Alt starter med deg. Å jobbe på et av våre hoteller betyr å være en del av et team der omtanke, samarbeid og små øyeblikk i hverdagen gjør en forskjell. Du er med på å skape den varme, hjemmekoselig følelsen som kjennetegner Scandic – ved å være til stede, her og nå, og la detaljene telle.

Noen dager går fort, andre er mer forutsigbare – ingen dager er helt like. Men det som alltid består, er lagånden. Dere stiller opp for hverandre, løser ting når de oppstår og er stolte av å levere kvalitet – selv når tempoet er høyt. Og når dere gjør det, vil gjestene ikke bare nyte oppholdet – de får lyst til å komme tilbake.

Slik jobber vi i Scandic

Vi er på vårt beste når vi jobber sammen – på tvers av roller, hoteller og team – og fokuserer på det som virkelig gjør en forskjell i hverdagen. Våre verdier veileder oss i hvordan vi møter hverandre og hvordan vi leverer: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring og Be You.

Hvis du mener at ekte gjestfrihet skapes gjennom samarbeid, jevn kvalitet og små øyeblikk gjort godt, vil du føle deg hjemme hos oss.

jobs.title: Researcher wanted for the Department of Depression and Anxiety, Aarhus University Hospital / Forsker søges til Afdeling For Depression og Angst, AUH
jobs.description:
Forskningsenheden under Afdeling for Depression og Angst (ADA) ved Aarhus Universitetshospital søger kandidater til en tidsbegrænset stilling (18 måneder) pr. 01. december 2026 som forsker med fokus på udvikling af maskinlæringsalgoritmer til forudsigelse af kliniske outcomes hos patienter med psykisk sygdom.

Om forskningsenheden

ADA er en del af Aarhus Universitetshospital. Vii tilbyder udredning og behandling af høj faglig kvalitet til voksne patienter med lidelser inden for det affektive spektrum. Afdelingens forskningsenhed består af en professor samt ca. 20 fuldtids- og deltidsforskere. Forskningsenheden har stor faglig diversitet og rummer bl.a. læger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, programmører og en statistiker.

Arbejdsopgaver

Arbejdsopgaverne vil bl.a. omfatte

  • selvstændig forskning med fokus på udvikling og validering af maskinlæringsalgoritmer
  • publikation af forskningsresultater
  • sparring med øvrige forskere i Forskningsenheden
  • bidrag til fondsansøgninger
  • deltagelse ved seminarer og konferencer
  • vejledning af yngre forskere og studerende.

Vi tilbyder

  • en stilling i et stærkt tværfagligt forskningsmiljø
  • tæt samarbejde med kliniske miljøer
  • mulighed for nationale og internationale samarbejder.

Ønskede faglige kvalifikationer

  • erfaring med forskning i maskinlæring med anvendelse af sundhedsdata (ideelt journaldata)
  • formel forskningsuddannelse
  • erfaring med publikation af forskningsdata i tidsskrifter med peer review
  • stærke samarbejdskompetencer og erfaring med tværgående samarbejde
  • forstår, taler og kan skrive dansk og engelsk (datamaterialet består bl.a. af journaltekst på dansk).

Ansættelsesforhold

Der er tale om en tidsbegrænset fuldtidsstilling (18 måneder) med opstart d. 1. december 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børne- og straffeattest.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Professor Søren Dinesen Østergaard på tlf. 6128 2753 eller på mail soeoes@rm.dk.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 22. september 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt d. 24. september 2026.

ENGELSK VERSION 

Researcher

The research unit of the Department of Affective Disorders at Aarhus University Hospital is seeking candidates for a fixed-term position (18 months) as researcher with a focus on developing machine learning algorithms to predict clinical outcomes in patients with mental illness.

About the research unit

The Department of Affective Disorders is part of Aarhus University Hospital. We offer high-quality assessment and treatment for adult patients with affective disorders. The department's research unit consists of a professor and approximately 20 full-time and part-time researchers. The research unit has substantial professional diversity and includes, among others, doctors, psychologists, nurses, programmers and a statistician.

Tasks

  • independent research with a focus on the development and validation of machine learning algorithms
  • publication of research results
  • sparring with other researchers in the research unit
  • contribution to grant applications
  • participation in seminars and conferences
  • supervision of younger researchers and students.

We offer

  • a strong interdisciplinary research environment
  • close collaboration with clinical colleagues
  • opportunity for national and international collaborations.

Desired professional qualifications

  • experience with research in machine learning using health data (ideally medical record data)
  • formal research training
  • experience with publication of research data in peer-reviewed journals
  • strong collaboration skills and experience with interdisciplinary collaboration
  • understands, speaks and can write Danish and English (A main data source is medical record text in Danish).

Employment conditions

This is a full-time, fixed-term position (18 months) starting on December 1st, 2026.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. The employment is conditioned by a satifying child criminal record.

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Søren Dinesen Østergaard at +45 6128 2753 or by mail soeoes@rm.dk.

Application deadline is September 22nd 2026 and the interviews are expected to be held on September 24th, 2026.

 

 

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner (Lyon, France)
jobs.description:
Location : Lyon, France

About ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team

  • An international team (with more than 38 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
  • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity, Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), MandA (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry

Requirements

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Acting as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and the Data/AI leadership, you will ensure that AI initiatives are delivered with strategic alignment, operational rigor, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Ensure AI solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively across business lines

 

2.        Backlog Management

·       Own, prioritize and continuously refine the product backlog in collaboration with business & development teams

·       Ensure delivery cadence is maintained and risks are proactively escalated

3.        Business Partnering and Change Management

·       Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, gathering needs, managing expectations and driving adoption

·       Support business teams in understanding AI capabilities and in defining use cases with high ROI potential

·       Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth integration of AI tools into existing workflows

·       Manage & develop support materials

 

4.       AI Expertise and Innovation

·       Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of AI/ML trends, tools and best practices relevant to company’s needs

·       Evaluate new AI solutions and vendors, providing informed recommendations to the ISD leadership

·       Ensure responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, data privacy …) throughout product development & usage

 

5.       Coordination and Governance

·       Coordinate cross-functional teams (Compliance, Cyber, Business) to ensure end-to-end delivery

·       Define and monitor KPIs to track product performance and adoption

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Experience: Minimum 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with at least one significant AI or data-driven product deployment

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

·       Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)

·       Experience in financial services, private equity or healthcare is a plus

jobs.title: Risk Analyst – Swedbank Robur
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta i hjärtat av riskhantering på ett fondbolag där kvalitet, integritet och affärsförståelse går hand i hand? Vi söker nu tre seniora medarbetare till vår andra linjens riskfunktion – en nyckelroll för att säkerställa en stark riskkultur och välfungerande fondverksamhet.

Om rollen:

I denna roll arbetar du oberoende av affären med att säkerställa att verksamheten verkar inom fastställda riskramar, investeringslimiter och regulatoriska krav. Du arbetar nära förvaltning, juridik och compliance och blir en viktig rådgivare i komplexa regulatoriska frågor.

Du kommer också spela en viktig roll i att vidareutveckla arbetssätt och processer – med fokus på effektivitet, kvalitet och skalbarhet.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Utföra oberoende riskkontroll och säkerställa efterlevnad av fastställda riskramar, investeringslimiter och regulatoriska krav.

    

Övervaka och analysera marknadsrisk och likviditetsrisk samt bedöma risknivåer i relation till fondstrategier och investeringsmandat.

    

Ansvara för flaggningsbedömningar av större aktieinnehav.

    

Identifiera och analysera limitöverträdelser, samt följa upp korrigerande åtgärder.

    

Genomföra löpande kontroller och säkerställa kvalitativ dokumentation och regelefterlevnad.

    

Tolka och omsätta regelverk och interna styrdokument i praktiken.

    

Agera rådgivande och utbildande gentemot verksamheten.

    

Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och driva initiativ för att effektivisera och automatisera processer, exempelvis genom ökad användning av dataanalys och AI.

I denna roll behöver du:

    

Flerårig erfarenhet från fondbolag, bank eller liknande – gärna inom compliance, risk eller kontrollfunktion.

    

Mycket god kunskap om regelverk såsom LVF, UCITS, AIFMD och flaggningsregler.

    

Djup förståelse för investeringsbegränsningar, limituppföljning samt marknadsrisk och likviditetsrisk.

    

Stark analytisk förmåga och vana att arbeta med stora datamängder.

    

Erfarenhet av portfölj- eller compliance-system.

    

Ett genuint intresse av att förbättra och förenkla processer, gärna med hjälp av ny teknik som automatisering och AI.

    

Swedsec-licens.

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:

    

Har hög integritet och ett starkt professionellt omdöme.

    

Är strukturerad, noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten.

    

Arbetar självständigt, tar initiativ och driver dina frågor framåt.

    

Är analytisk och lösningsorienterad.

    

Kommunicerar tydligt och pedagogiskt, även i komplexa frågor.

    

Har lätt för att samarbeta och bygga förtroende i organisationen.

    

Trivs i en dynamisk och föränderlig miljö och motiveras av att utveckla smartare och mer effektiva arbetssätt.

Hos oss kan du uppleva:

    

Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.

    

Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.

    

En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.

    

En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.

    

Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.

jobs.title: IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor
jobs.description:
Help us build QWC’s new Rope Access Department

QWC.dk ApS is a Danish window cleaning and specialist access company based in Glostrup. We carry out professional window cleaning, glass restoration and complex assignments where specialist access methods are required.

We are now establishing a dedicated rope access department and are looking for an experienced, proactive and hands-on IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor who wants to help build the department from the beginning.

The position

As our Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor, you will be responsible for the daily planning, supervision and safe execution of QWC’s rope access operations.

The position combines on-site supervision, practical rope access work, safety planning and client communication. You will work alongside the team and play a central role in developing our procedures, equipment setup and working methods.

You will have the authority and responsibility to stop any operation that you consider unsafe.

Main responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Planning and supervising rope access operations at sites throughout Denmark

  • Preparing and maintaining risk assessments, APV documentation, method statements and rescue plans

  • Conducting pre-work briefings and toolbox talks

  • Ensuring that all work is carried out safely and in accordance with Danish legislation, QWC procedures and applicable IRATA standards

  • Selecting and checking rope access systems, rigging and anchor points within your professional competence

  • Establishing exclusion zones and protecting clients, employees and members of the public

  • Supervising rope access technicians and verifying that team members have the necessary qualifications and competence

  • Inspecting, controlling and documenting rope access equipment and personal protective equipment

  • Planning emergency and rescue procedures

  • Communicating with clients before, during and after assignments

  • Participating directly in practical rope access work, including window cleaning and specialist façade and glass assignments

  • Assisting with other window cleaning operations during periods without scheduled rope access work

  • Helping QWC develop a professional, efficient and safety-focused rope access department

Your qualifications

We expect that you:

  • Hold a valid IRATA Level 3 certificate

  • Have an up-to-date and correctly maintained IRATA logbook

  • Hold a current and relevant first aid certificate

  • Have practical experience supervising rope access operations

  • Have strong knowledge of risk assessment, rescue planning, equipment control and safe systems of work

  • Can communicate professionally in spoken and written English

  • Can communicate clearly with technicians, management and clients

  • Are proactive, responsible and comfortable making safety-critical decisions

  • Take a practical approach and are willing to work alongside the team

  • Can work independently and remain calm in demanding situations

  • Are willing to travel to different work locations throughout Denmark

  • Are physically capable of carrying out rope access work

Danish language skills are an advantage, but they are not a requirement. English is required.

Experience with window cleaning, façade cleaning, building maintenance or similar specialist work is an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

Employment terms

  • Position: IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor

  • Employment: Full-time

  • Working hours: 37 hours per week

  • Salary payment: Monthly in arrears

  • Primary base: QWC.dk ApS, Glostrup, Denmark

  • Place of work: Various client locations throughout Denmark

  • Holiday entitlement: In accordance with the Danish Holiday Act

  • Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement

  • Notice periods: In accordance with the employment contract and applicable Danish law

Employment is conditional upon the candidate obtaining and maintaining any residence and work permit required to work legally in Denmark.

About QWC

QWC is a growing Danish window cleaning company with extensive experience in professional window cleaning and challenging specialist assignments. We focus on high-quality work, professional communication and safe, practical solutions.

This is an opportunity to join us at an early stage in the development of our new rope access department and have real influence on how the department is built and operated.

How to apply

Please send the following in English:

  • Your CV

  • A short application

  • A copy of your valid IRATA Level 3 certificate

  • Documentation of your current first aid qualification

  • A summary of your relevant rope access and supervisory experience

Send your application to kontakt@qwc.dk with the subject line:

“IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor”

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200090 - Mechanical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

jobs.title: Thon Hotel Oslo Airport søker Konferansevert
jobs.description:

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

jobs.title: Är du en social kille i 20–25-årsåldern som söker ett meningsfullt extrajob
jobs.description:
Hjelpa är ett assistansbolag som startades för att förnya assistansbranschen. Vi vill visa att kompetens och kvalitet i kombination med respekt, tro och glädje gör skillnad. För varje individ och för samhället i stort. Nyckeln till att lyckas med det är våra medarbetare.

Vänta inte med din ansökan. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Vill du bli en av oss?

Vi söker en personlig assistent till en 17-årig kille i Malmö. Här får du ett jobb där du blir en viktig del av någons vardag – samtidigt som ni har roligt tillsammans.

Efter skolan handlar det om att hänga, hitta på aktiviteter och vara ett stöd i det som behövs. Ingen dag är den andra lik, och det är just det som gör jobbet så roligt.

Exempel på vad ni kan göra tillsammans:
Hjälpas åt med läxor och skolarbete
Spela spel, träna eller hitta på andra roliga aktiviteter
Gå ut, ta en promenad eller hitta på något kul i stan
Prata fotboll, gaming eller andra gemensamma intressen
Vara ett tryggt och positivt stöd i vardagen
Arbetstider

Vardagar: 16.00–20.00
Varannan helg: Dagtid

Vem söker vi?

Vi tror att du är en kille i 20–25-årsåldern som är social, trygg och har lätt för att skapa en bra relation med ungdomar. Du tar egna initiativ, är lyhörd och kan anpassa dig efter dagsform och intressen.

Du har gärna ett intresse för fotboll, gaming, träning eller andra aktiviteter som en 17-åring uppskattar. Det viktigaste är dock att du är en positiv person som kan bli en naturlig och engagerad förebild och kompis i vardagen.

Erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller arbete inom omsorg är meriterande, men inget krav. Vi lägger störst vikt vid din personlighet och att du och kunden trivs tillsammans.

Låter det som något för dig?

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Vi rekryterar löpande, så vänta inte – tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Ops Specialist - FREELANCE (H/F/X)

Comprenant 300 collaborateurs et des filiales dans de nombreux pays (France, Belgique, Suisse, Italie, République Tchèque, Emirats Arabes Unis, Brésil…), le groupe s’appuie sur sa capacité à fédérer l’excellence, via l’intégration d’expertises publicitaires leader de leur marché, de manière à concevoir et piloter des stratégies de communication 360 à l'échelle l’internationale.

  • Évaluer l’adéquation de Salesforce avec les processus et besoins métiers.

  • Recueillir et formaliser les besoins des utilisateurs et des équipes métiers.

  • Cadrer les évolutions et assurer leur recette fonctionnelle.

4. Coordination IT & Cabinet Salesforce

  • Être l’interlocuteur référent Salesforce auprès des équipes métiers, de l’IT et du cabinet partenaire.

  • Challenger les recommandations et solutions proposées par le cabinet.
  • Assurer le suivi des développements, des recettes et des mises en production.

5. Roadmap & Recommandations

  • Construire une roadmap Salesforce à court, moyen et long terme.
  • Prioriser les actions et évolutions à mener.
  • Assurer un rôle de conseil et d’expertise auprès des équipes internes afin de maximiser la valeur et l’utilisation de Salesforce.

 

👉 Profil recherché

  • Solide expérience en audit, optimisation et évolution de Salesforce

  • Profil à la fois fonctionnel et technique

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux métiers, data et processus

  • Capacité à challenger l’existant et être force de proposition

  • Forte autonomie et capacité à structurer une roadmap

  • Expérience dans la coordination avec les équipes IT et un cabinet Salesforce

  • Capacité à piloter les évolutions, développements et recettes

jobs.title: Vil du gjøre en forskjell? Guro (25) søker BPA-assistenter og fagansvarlig

Spesielt ettertraktet er du som trives med å jobbe ettermiddager, kvelder, netter, helger og i høytider.

Som BPA-assistent vil du bidra til at hverdagen min fungerer best mulig. Du vil være en viktig støtte i både praktiske oppgaver og sosiale situasjoner, samtidig som du hjelper meg med å tilpasse aktivitetene etter dagsform og energinivå.

Vi ser etter deg som
  • Er rolig, trygg og omsorgsfull

  • Klarer å sette pris på rolige stunder, humor og gode samtaler
  • Er observant og tilpasser deg ulike dagsformer

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner

Vi tilbyr

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte koordinator Agnethe Lynn Ytrøy på ay@assent.no.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Assent har organisert BPA-tjenester siden 2014. I dag har vi konsesjon på levering av BPA i flere kommuner over hele landet. Vi har medarbeidere med god kjennskap til ordningen og arbeidsgiverrollen, samt lang erfaring med organisering av individuelle tjenester både i og utenfor hjemmet. jobs.title: Experienced Engineers to a Global Company in Ludvika
jobs.description:
Our client is a global technology company within power transmission and electrification. The organization designs, builds, and upgrades high-voltage transmission installations that move electricity across regions and countries, and its technology is a key enabler of the ongoing energy transition. The site in Ludvika is one of the company's main engineering centres in Sweden, with a large international engineering community and a strong technical tradition.

About HVDC Service

The HVDC Service organisation works with upgrades, service and warranty support for HVDC installations already in operation around the world. Since these installations have a lifespan of around many years and are upgraded regularly, this is a long, ongoing pipeline of brownfield engineering work. The organisation is now expanding significantly, and we're looking for several engineers who want to be part of that journey long-term.

What we're looking for

Across all areas below, we are looking for experienced engineers with several years of relevant industry experience. Experience within high voltage power systems or HVDC is important and highly meritorius.

We are looking for engineers within several different areas and the descriptions are meant to give you a sense of each team and the type of background that tends to fit – not to draw hard lines between them.

By submitting your application, you're registering your interest in talking further about the different opportunities with our client. This is proactive, ongoing recruitment work across several technical areas, and together, through dialogue, we'll land on the role where you, your experience and competencies will fit best.

SCADA, HMI, IT/OT & Cyber Security

SCADA Engineers, HMI Engineers, IT/OT Engineers, System Engineers and Cyber Security Engineers for HVDC upgrade projects, with a growing cyber security scope.

Keywords: SCADA, HMI, IT/OT, industrial control, data communication, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, DNP3, MicroSCADA, AVEVA System Platform

Control & Protection, SCADA and Automation (Service & Warranty)

HVDC Project Engineers, SCADA Engineers, HMI Engineers, Automation Engineers and Control & Protection Engineers for service, warranty and upgrade projects on existing installations.

Keywords: control systems, automation, verification & testing, HMI, SCADA, Siemens PCS7, ABB 800xA, PLC programming

Station Control Monitoring & Cyber Security

Project Engineers, SCADA Engineers, HMI Engineers, Station Control Monitoring Engineers and Cyber Security Engineers for station control monitoring and base services & warranty work.

Keywords: SCADA, HMI, cyber security, station control monitoring, communication protocols, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, EtherCAT

Control & Protection Programming & Power Systems

Control & Protection Engineers, Power System Engineers, Automation Engineers and Software Engineers for programming-intensive design and upgrade work on HVDC control & protection systems.

Keywords: programming, power systems, digital/analog signals, hardware & software, C/C++, DSP, EtherCAT

Electrical Design & Hardware Engineering

Electrical Design Engineers, Hardware Engineers and Electrical Engineers for hardware design and documentation of control & protection systems, including circuit diagrams, layouts and CAD-based technical documentation.

Keywords: CAD, technical documentation, circuit diagrams, structured technical work, post-secondary education within electrical/electronics/automation, Engineering Base, cable dimensioning and cable lists

Note: fluent Swedish is a requirement for this specific team.

Personal qualities

You take ownership of your work, ask questions when something is unclear, and share what you know with the people around you. You are patient and eager to learn a complex technology properly and are ready to both work individually and collaborate as part of a team. We are looking for people who want to settle in the region long term and contribute to the continuous growth of the organization.

Additional information

• Location: Ludvika, Sweden. On site.

• Travel: The positions can include both national and global travels. The duration varies by role, from very limited to longer regular assignments.

• Start date: According to agreement – we are recruiting continuously.

• Employment type: You will initially be employed by A-hub as a consultant, with the ambition of moving to direct employment with our client after 12 months

• Security screening: Background and security checks will be conducted as part of the recruitment process. Some roles require Swedish citizenship.

A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy (https://www.a-hub.se/integritetspolicy).

jobs.title: Service Engineer Analyzers
jobs.description:
Would you like to work with advanced automation technology and become a trusted partner to our customers?

Join our Scandinavian team specializing in analyzers and measurement equipment for the pulp and paper industry. We offer a dynamic work environment where you can grow your career while working with market-leading products alongside a highly skilled and supportive team.

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the performance and reliability of online fiber and pulp analyzers, as well as laboratory analyzers.

You will be responsible for the entire service process, from planning and execution to follow-up activities. As an important point of contact for our customers, you will work closely with technical experts in our local team and the product group based in Kajaani, Finland.

Responsibilities:

    Service Engineer for analyzers and measurement equipment
    Perform service, troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs at customer sites
    Plan, execute, and report on your own service visits
    Commission and calibrate new equipment
    Provide remote support via telephone and remote connection tools
    Collaborate with the Scandinavian sales team and the product group in Kajaani, Finland

Qualifications

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent experience
    Experience with analyzers or consistency measurement systems is considered an advantage
    Knowledge of the pulp and paper industry
    Strong teamwork skills combined with the ability to work independently
    Fluency in Swedish and English
    Valid driver's license (Category B) and willingness to travel within Scandinavia as customer site visits are a significant part of the role

We are looking for someone who is proactive, technically skilled, solution-oriented, and enjoys working closely with customers.

We Offer

We offer an international working environment with exciting development opportunities. You will work with the latest automation technology and take on interesting customer assignments that provide both challenge and variety in your daily work.

You will become part of a professional team that supports your growth and continuously drives quality improvements and innovation. To ensure the best possible start, we provide a comprehensive introduction to Valmet and our products.

Additional Information

Interested? Submit your application through the link above as soon as possible, but no later than September 22, 2026.

For more information about the position, please contact:

Fredrik Persson, Service Engineer

fredrik.persson@valmet.com

Mattias Mollstedt, Service Manager

mattias.mollstedt@valmet.com

Please note that we will not accept applications via e-mail.

We perform background checks and alcohol and drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

Join the team and lead the way with us!

jobs.title: JAG Assistanse søker personlig assistent til beredskapsstilling hos en hyggelig mann med en godt etablert BPA-ordning
jobs.description:
Jeg er en blid kar som har masse humor og som er lett og trivelig å være sammen med. Jeg har en egen enebolig nord i Haugesund, samt egen bil. Jeg er oppegående og mobil. I dag har jeg seks stabile assistenter og vil gjerne ha deg med på laget!

Ledig stilling:

Lønnsmessig utgjør stillingen i gjennomsnitt 12,7t betalt per uke fordelt som 4,8t aktiv vakt og 7,9t beredskap. Når du er i aktivt arbeid, bor du hjemme hos meg. Der har du eget soverom og bad. Om natten kan du sove som vanlig, så sant det ikke oppstår noe uventet. I beredskap kan du være hjemme hos deg selv og leve som normalt samtidig som du får lønn.

Du kan gjerne ha annet arbeid i tillegg, men når du etter din turnus er betalt for å være i beredskap, må du kunne gå ifra og komme inn til aktivt arbeid dersom det blir bruk for deg. Det er ikke ofte det skjer og vanligvis vet du i god tid at du må inn.

Noen ganger kan du bli spurt om du kan gå ekstra, f.eks. ved aktiviteter, ferier ogfravær hos de andre assistentene.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Bistå med lett personlig stell, husarbeid og matlaging
  • Bli med på turer og aktiviteter ute og inne

Ønsket kompetanse:

Du får god opplæring og tilvenning. Du trenger ikke spesiell utdanning selv om det selvsagt er en fordel, men det er fint om du har noe erfaring med personer med funksjonsnedsettelser eller egne barn.

Krav i stillingen:

  • Plettfri vandel/politiattest
  • Gode norskkunnskaper
  • Førerkort
  • Ikke-røyker

Emosjonelle krav:

Det stilles emosjonelle krav i stillingen. Emosjonelle krav handler om de følelsesmessige kravene som stilles til arbeidstaker i møte med andre. Håndtering av egne og andres følelser er en viktig del av jobben. I rollen som personlig assistent kan man komme i situasjoner hvor man må justere og/eller beherske egne følelser, samt håndtere andre menneskers følelser inkludert sorger og gleder. Dette gås gjennom på intervju og ved praktisk opplæring på arbeidsplassen.

Som personlig assistent i JAG utgjør du en forskjell hver dag, og personlig egnethet er avgjørende.

Lønn:

JAG Assistanse følger Tariffavtale (Landsoverenskomsten for BPA). Lønnsplassering ut fra dokumentert ansiennitet ved ansettelse. Relevant erfaring kan være BPA-assistent, barne- og ungdomsarbeider, førskolelærer, helsefagarbeider mm. Det må tilsvarer minimum 50% stilling.

Timelønn ved 35,5 t/u
_______________________________________________


Ansiennitet | 0 år | 3 år | 6 år | 9 år |
Timelønn kr | 236,49 | 241,91 | 250,04 | 258,16 |

______________________________________________

Tillegg for ubekvem arbeidstid

Kveld og natt: kr 67,00
Helg: kr 70,00

Kveld/natt- og helgetillegg ihht. tariffavtalen.

Dersom du har relevant erfaring/utdannelse vil du ved en eventuell ansettelse i JAG bes om å fremlegge denne dokumentasjonen. Vi oppfordrer alle til å legge ved attester/vitnemål med søknaden.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

JAG Assistanse AS (JAG) er en ideell leverandør av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) og styrer etter non-profitt prinsippet. JAG har bred kompetanse på organisering av BPA-tjenester, spesielt for personer med sammensatte funksjonsnedsettelser, hvorav en kan være av kognitiv art. Vi arbeider for at alle uavhengig av funksjonsnedsettelse skal kunne leve sine liv fullt ut på egne vilkår, og skreddersyr hver enkelt BPA-ordning.

JAG er landsdekkende og arbeidsgiver for over 1000 ansatte, og det legges stor vekt på kvalitetssikring, opplæring og videreutvikling. Verdigrunnlaget i JAG bygger på Independent Living og grunnleggende menneskerettigheter, som også gjenspeiles i JAGs kulturkode.

jobs.title: Account Manager

Vi söker dig som tycker om att vara nära kunden, förstå deras verksamhet och behov och omsätta detta till konkreta affärsmöjligheter.

Rollen passar dig som uppskattar frihet under ansvar, tydliga affärsmål och möjligheten att påverka. Du blir en viktig länk mellan kunden och Carpenter och arbetar nära kollegor inom försäljning, kundservice, produktion, teknik och projekt.

DINA HUVUDSAKLIGA ARBETSUPPGIFTER

    Utveckla och fördjupa relationerna med Carpenters strategiska kunder
    Identifiera, utveckla och vinna nya affärer och kunder

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Background

Melt&Marble’s mission is to accelerate the transition towards more sustainable products. We harness precision fermentation to create the next generation of sustainable designer fats, tailored for applications ranging from delicious, climate-friendly foods to high-performance personal care products.

Position summary

We are looking for a hands-on Manufacturing Operations Specialist to support the commercialization and scale-up of Melt&Marble’s products.

This role combines manufacturing coordination, quality and compliance management, logistics coordination, and project management. The successful candidate will work closely with our manufacturing partners, testing laboratories, customers, and internal teams to ensure that production lots move smoothly from manufacturing through quality control, documentation, and delivery.

You will also liaise with manufacturing partners, testing laboratories, suppliers, logistics providers, customers, and internal teams to establish scalable systems as we grow from pilot production to commercial volumes.

Our ideal candidate should have experience coordinating manufacturing, quality, supply chain, or operational activities within industries such as food, ingredients, biotechnology, fermentation, specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, or related fields. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating structure, building systems, managing multiple stakeholders, and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks.

The candidate should be comfortable working in the dynamic environment of a startup company, handling multiple projects simultaneously, and helping establish scalable systems.

Occasionally, some activities may require working outside of standard office hours. The position may require occasional travel within Sweden and abroad.



Main Responsibilities & Tasks

Manufacturing coordination

    Coordinate external manufacturing partners and track production from fermentation, extraction, through testing, packaging, and delivery, ensuring that materials, packaging, and labelling are ready in time for production.
    Manage production-related supply dependencies: purchase/delivery timelines, lead times, backorders, and shipment readiness.
    Coordinate logistics across partners/facilities: shipments, dispatch, tracking, and delivery coordination to customers.
    Identify supply risks (material shortages, delayed packaging, logistics constraints, dependency bottlenecks) and proactively escalate with mitigation actions.



Quality, Traceability & Compliance  

    Ensure complete, organized quality and compliance documentation for each production lot.
    Coordinate quality control and external testing activities, including specifications, Certificates of Analysis (CoAs), batch records, traceability, batch release documentation, etc.
    Maintain traceability linking materials to batch records, test results, CoAs, etc.
    Coordinate and validate supplier documentation required for compliance (e.g., incoming quality documentation, supplier qualification support).
    Support continuous improvement of quality documentation workflows to reduce errors, delays, and nonconformities.

  

Operational Systems & Cross-Functional Coordination

    Identify and implement improvements to manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and product flow processes.
    Help establish scalable operational systems (documentation structure, release checklists, partner SOP alignment, inventory/document tracking support).
    Coordinate cross-functional projects by tracking timelines, deliverables, and follow-up actions across internal teams.

Required qualifications

    BSc, MSc, or PhD in biotechnology, food science, chemistry, chemical engineering, supply chain, operations, or a related field.
    3+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, quality, supply chain, logistics, technical operations, or a related role within food, ingredients, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals, personal care, or another regulated manufacturing industry.
    Solid understanding of quality systems, traceability, and compliance requirements in a manufacturing environment (e.g. GMP, HACCP, ISO-based quality systems, supplier qualification, batch documentation, or related frameworks).
    Hands-on experience maintaining or coordinating quality and compliance documentation such as batch records, specifications, CoAs, supplier documentation, testing records, and traceability systems.  
    Experience coordinating activities involving multiple external partners, suppliers, laboratories, or manufacturers.
    Understanding of manufacturing processes in biotechnology, food ingredients, specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, or related industries.
    Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
    Good written and oral communication skills in English.
    Proactive, flexible, and hands-on, with the ability to work independently and thrive in a startup environment.

Bonus points

    Hands-on experience with contract manufacturing partners.
    Understanding of microbial fermentation, downstream processing, or other batch manufacturing processes.
    Experience with lipids.
    Experience coordinating international shipments, customs, or import/export activities.
    Experience implementing operational, inventory, ERP, quality management, or document management systems.
    Familiarity with customer-facing quality and compliance documentation requirements.



We offer

    An innovative, interdisciplinary, & fun research environment where you can rapidly grow your skillset and advance in your career
    Opportunity to participate in and make meaningful contributions to innovative projects that address key global challenges
    Competitive remuneration, generous vacation package, & other benefits



Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.



How to Apply:

Applications should be in English and contain:

    Cover letter- tell us why you’re a great fit for Melt&Marble and this particular position (300 words max!)
    CV outlining your experience, education, and key skills, including contact information of 2 current/former supervisors and 1 current/former colleague



Deadline: September 30th. Note that we might evaluate applications as they are received, so please apply early!



For any questions, please email hr@meltmarble.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
​Senior Software Developer - Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U)

Do you want to make the world a safer place while being part of a team that truly values experience and collaboration?

Would you like to join a global and technically skilled team that plays an essential role in Verisure’s success?

The platform organisation in Malmö develops and operates the software that underpins Verisure's alarm and smart home systems. We are responsible for the services that keep millions of connected devices online, upgradeable, and traceable, from the moment a device is manufactured until it is returned or decommissioned.

About the role

As a Senior Software Developer in Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U), you will join a team of around 11 backend engineers building and operating a portfolio of internal platform services. These cover device lifecycle management (factory provisioning, firmware upgrades, SIM management) and internal operator and support tooling used daily by Verisure technicians and administrators. Several of these services run with 24/7 SLA requirements; device provisioning and support tooling are business-critical, always-on parts of the platform.

You will design, build, and operate microservices spanning device lifecycle management, SIM connectivity, firmware/upgrade orchestration, and internal utility tooling. You will work closely with the team's Product Owner, fellow developers, and PU&U's external EMS partners to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into reliable software. You are expected to take technical ownership of parts of the system, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor less experienced developers.

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation, not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages, spanning millions of connected devices, is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Location: Malmö (5-minute walk from the Central Station)

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation — not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages — spanning millions of connected devices — is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced backend developer with a strong technical foundation and the confidence to take ownership of complex, business-critical services. You enjoy working in an environment with a long-term technical vision but shifting short-term priorities, and you communicate clearly with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders. You take pride in code quality, system reliability, and helping the team improve its ways of working.

Required:

    Several years of hands-on experience as a backend software developer, ideally in a microservice/distributed systems environment
    Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot
    Experience with containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes)
    Fluency in English (verbal and written)

Also, great if you have:

    Experience with message-driven architecture (e.g. RabbitMQ)
    Experience with relational databases (e.g. MySQL)
    Frontend experience (React/JavaScript) is a plus, though not the core focus of the role
    Familiarity with device lifecycle management, IoT connectivity, or hardware/software integration
    Experience working in an environment with external hardware/manufacturing partners
    AWS experience

About Verisure

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.

Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.

Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.

My team and I eagerly await your application! Join us on this journey towards a safer, smarter world. Apply today!

If you have questions regarding this position, please reach out to our Group Senior TA Specialist, Robert Jonasson, at robert.jonasson@verisure.com

Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international company with offices and colleagues in multiple countries.

Verisure - 35 years of delivering peace of mind.

jobs.title: Technology Risk & Controls Manager
jobs.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description  

This role sits within the Controls function, reporting to the Head of Controls. You will be an integral part of an action orientated, fast moving team, responsible for successfully delivering First Line of Defence capability within the bank.     

Role Description 

  • You will partner with the Technology business area to embed the Risk Management Framework, including policies and procedures.

  • Provide expert input into the design and operation of the technology control framework, including data management, working with stakeholders across Technology to ensure that controls are documented and embedded. 

  • Provide expert input into the vendor management framework, supporting the Vendor Management Team to develop and embed controls to ensure effective management of vendors in line with regulatory requirements. 

  • Testing of existing and new key controls in line with agreed schedule, informing the non-financial risk profile and required management actions.  

  • Support the operational resilience programme, with a focus on technology resilience, feeding into scenario planning and testing. 

  • Support the coordination and facilitation of the bank’s Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and administration of the bank’s annual RCSA refresh. 

  • Support the capital calculation for Operational Risk as part of the ICAAP, including scenario analysis. 

  • Hands on support in the update of risk information on the bank’s Risk systems, including ensuring risk events and issues are appropriately raised and managed. 

  • Assembling informed quantitative and qualitative input into First Line Risk Reporting at relevant committees and conducting deep dive reviews into areas of thematic risk. 

Principal Accountabilities 

  • As the Risk Business Partner for Technology, provide hands-on Risk support from a First Line Controls perspective. 

  • Partner with the business to ensure ongoing active management of risk and embedding of the Risk Management Framework, including RCSA, risk events, issues, KRIs. 

  • Support the development of the technology control framework, including data and vendor management. 

  • Provide First Line assurance over key controls, through control testing and supporting operational resilience assessment and testing. 

  • Deputise as required at meetings for the Head of Controls. 

  • Support the ongoing monitoring and reporting of risk through relevant governance, conducting analysis and reporting on key areas of risk, including internal and external reporting.  

  • Help promote a risk-focused culture across the bank, embodying Allica’s values. 

Personal Attributes & Experience 

  • Strong Risk knowledge and experience including RCSAs, Controls and Risk Libraries, risk event reporting,  

  • Expertise in technology control frameworks and vendor management standards.  

  • Knowledge of ISO27001 and SOC2 type controls would be advantageous. 

  • Knowledge of relevant non-financial risk regulatory requirements, e.g. on Operational Resilience, Outsourcing is desirable.  

  • Hands on experience of assurance/monitoring of risks and controls across non-financial risk disciplines  

  • Willing to be very hands-on and ability to adapt quickly to the workflow in support of the Controls team, with focus on delivering results and meeting deadlines. 

  • Strong written and presentation skills, supported by experience of communication across different levels of seniority. 

  • Ability to provide necessary challenge in a constructive manner. 

  • Strong team player, with focus on ongoing development to support meeting objective of the team. 

  • Overall, 10-12 years of experience in operational risk management, RCSA administration and ICAAP compliance with deep expertise in internal controls. 

  • Proven experience in developing and overseeing vendor risk management frameworks including 3rd party risk assessment, ongoing monitoring and compliance

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity
