jobs.description:
Senior Rider Onboarding Associate

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Senior Rider Onboarding Associate to join our UKI team. This is a remote, field-based Fixed Term Contract (FTC) role with operational roots in Edinburgh, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, or London. In this role, you’ll help us build, scale, and optimise our physical onboarding ecosystem, directly securing the rider fleet capacity needed to power our three-sided marketplace.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Rider Enablement team. This sub-team acts as the operational foundation for rider supply across the United Kingdom and Ireland, managing logistical scaling challenges to ensure the fleet meets real-time marketplace demand.

Owing to the strategic scope of this seniority level, your responsibilities are split across two core operational pillars:

Strategy, Design & Scaling

  • Optimise hub performance: Evolve the format and structural workflow of our physical Rider Onboarding Hubs to maximise operational efficiency before, during, and after daily sessions.

  • Scale the footprint: Design, operationalise, and expand physical onboarding spaces across the UKI, implementing standardised systems to maintain high-quality service for all applicants.

  • Drive the strategic roadmap: Architect and execute the 12-month delivery plan for in-person onboarding, balancing expansion with strict time and cost efficiencies.

  • Cross-functional problem solving: Partner with Rider Support, Product, and broader Onboarding teams to troubleshoot live operational issues and funnel on-the-ground intelligence into long-term system enhancements.

Field Operations & Fleet Enablement

  • Deliver field onboarding: Travel extensively across the UKI to lead face-to-face onboarding sessions and support localized operations within regional hubs.

  • Manage local supply constraints: Target and eliminate rider deficits in hard-to-source zones, collaborating with the Supply team to build accurate demand forecasting models.

  • Execute seasonal campaigns: Lead tactical supply planning and execution for peak trading seasons to stay ahead of consumer and partner growth.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Sector experience: Proven operational experience within technology, start-ups, food delivery logistics, or direct experience working as a Deliveroo Rider.

  • Autonomy and resilience: A self-starter mindset with a demonstrated ability to work independently in the field, navigate changing operational priorities, and use your own initiative.

  • Stakeholder management: Strong empathetic listening and communication skills, with the capability to influence internal product teams and manage candidate groups.

  • Mobility and licensing: A valid UKI driving licence and access to your own vehicle for locations underserved by public transport, along with the flexibility to travel early and late.

Nice to Have

  • Technical tools: Familiarity with G Suite, Slack, Looker, and Salesforce tooling.

  • Language skills: Professional proficiency in Portuguese or Arabic.

Note: This is a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (FTC) with the possibility of extension. All field-based travel, accommodation, and personal vehicle mileage expenses will be fully covered by the company.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

 

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

 

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

 

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

 

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Core People Technology

Location: London | Work model: Hybrid | Reports to: Senior Manager, People Product

About the team

People Technology builds and runs the systems behind every hire, transfer, leave, pay change and offboard for our workforce across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to make the operational backbone of People Operations invisible when it works — reliable, compliant, and scalable across dozens of markets — so our people teams can focus on people, not process. This role sits on the People Product team, working alongside Business Systems Analysts, engineers and delivery leadership to bring product thinking to one of our highest-volume, highest-consequence surfaces.

About the role

Core is the Workday and HR platform surface that nearly every People Operations process runs through — pay, leave, employment status, right to work, and multi-country compliance for a global workforce. Demand structurally exceeds capacity, and requests arrive from every direction without a shared shape. You'll be the first dedicated product manager for this space, responsible for turning that inbound chaos into a defensible, well-communicated plan — and, over time, for building the intake, frameworks and partnerships that let the space run on systems rather than on you.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll be shaping tickets and sizing work alongside analysts and engineers, not managing from above.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why

  • Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes

  • Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship

  • Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work

  • Build and evolve the operating model across the analyst and engineering pod — the mechanisms, documentation and intake processes that let the space run with less coordination overhead

  • Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)

  • Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date

  • Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature

  • Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done

  • Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented

  • Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome

  • Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions

  • Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighborhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: SMB Account Manager - UKI
jobs.description:
SMB Account Manager

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for an SMB Account Manager to join our Manchester team. In this role, you’ll help our restaurant partners grow their businesses by improving their delivery operations, attracting new customers, and leveraging our latest technology to get the very best out of our platform.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the SMB (Small Medium Business) team in Manchester City Centre. We focus on high-velocity, desk-based relationship management, acting as the primary consultants for our diverse partner base to ensure their long-term success.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Strategic Portfolio Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts using a desk-based model, driving growth through phone, email, and video presentations.

  • Relationship Partnership: Build and maintain favourable, long-term relationships with partners, ensuring they receive exceptional service and tailored support.

  • Campaign Execution: Execute national and local marketing campaigns to improve key performance metrics, including order volume, retention, and customer outcomes.

  • Consultative Selling: Guide partners on how to offer the best delivery experience and take advantage of our latest technology and perks.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise between your restaurant partners and internal Deliveroo teams to ensure our solutions are delivered according to their specific needs.

Base Salary: £29,300 + up to £6,000 bonus yearly

Start Date: 5th October 2026

Hybrid model: 3 days in office / 2 days remote

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Proven Account Management: A track record in an account management role with experience in telephone-based support and selling.

  • Data-Led Problem Solving: The ability to understand problems and get to the crux of an issue quickly using data, without over-complicating solutions.

  • Creative Communication: An excellent phone manner and the ability to remove barriers through creativity and persuasive communication.

  • Tech Curiosity: A genuine enthusiasm for technology and a keenness to learn how digital tools can help partners excel in a competitive marketplace.

  • Results-Oriented: A proactive mindset focused on driving positive outcomes for both our partners and the Deliveroo business.

Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you!

  • Step 2: AI Screening & Assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to complete a short phone screening and online assessment with our AI assistant, Maki People. Things to note: this step must be completed to progress & If you can't find the link to the assessment in your inbox, please check your junk/spam!

  • Step 3: Recruiter Screen – You’ll have a 15-30 minute conversation with someone from Deliveroo to talk through your experience in more detail, learn more about the role, and get guidance on how to prepare for the next stages.

  • Step 4: Interview & Case Study – You’ll be invited to interview with one of our Managers, which may include a case study where you’ll present your findings (online or onsite).

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Founding Creative Director
jobs.description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the The Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The role

Siena is building the intelligence layer for CX, and we're about to launch several products in quick succession. We are not looking for someone to execute a brief well. We are looking for the person whose taste the rest of the company gets measured against: someone who looks at a landing page and can't not have an opinion, who would rather kill a launch than ship something mediocre, and who has owned creative direction before, not just contributed to it.

If you need a creative director above you setting the vision, a team to delegate to on day one, or a slow, considered, one-project-at-a-time pace, stop reading now. This isn't that job.

If you're the person other designers already defer to on taste, continue.

This is a craft title. Not a headcount title.

You will ship personally for the first year and set the bar for everyone who comes after. Over time you will build a small internal agency, two to three people across design, motion, and content, that can brief, position, and launch without outside help.

  • Narrative and positioning across every launch - design as strategy, not decoration

  • Every artifact that goes to market: landing pages, launch video, decks, social

  • The design system, from v3 onward

  • The bar, full stop - if it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

What it takes to be in the room

  • Taste, above everything, and evidence you can defend it. Specific, defended opinions about what's good and why.

  • A track record of owning creative direction, not just contributing to it. Agency or in-house, brand refresh or full launch - you've been the person whose call was final, not the one waiting on notes.

  • Narrative thinking. Design as positioning. You should already have a point of view on how a brand like Siena should be positioned, not just how it should look.

  • AI as a working tool, not a threat to your taste. You've already built something with AI - an app, a prototype, a mockup - and you want to get technical enough to ship a landing page yourself within a year. Anti-AI is disqualifying.

  • Range that travels. Your background doesn't have to be SaaS. Fashion, art, consumer brand, editorial - what matters is whether your taste holds up somewhere new.

  • A pattern of shipping in chaos, not around it. Multiple launches in flight, feedback that moves in hours not weeks. If your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline, that's useful information - it's just not this role.

Why this is worth it

You're not joining a design team to fit into. You're setting the taste bar for a company that's about to be a lot more visible, a lot faster than most companies get that chance.

This is intense - real ownership, real launches, a founder team that reviews your work directly and moves at the pace you'd expect from that. It's also one of the rare creative seats where nothing you make gets diluted by committee before it ships.

If that sounds like the room you've been trying to get into, we want to talk to you.

If it sounds like too much scrutiny too fast, this isn't a knock on you - it just isn't this role.

Why Siena?

  • Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

  • Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

  • A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

  • A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

  • Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

  • Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

  • AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.


Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.
No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

 

Why Join Us Now?

You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

  • £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

  • Over 1 million companies formed

The Role

This is a hands-on, mid-level role for a developer who is fluent in modern front-end fundamentals and confident translating design into clean, working code.

Working closely with designers and the wider engineering team, you'll turn Figma designs into pixel-accurate, responsive interfaces, and help build single page applications that are fast, accessible, and easy to maintain.

Front-End Development

• Build and maintain web applications using HTML, JavaScript, and Node.js

Design Implementation

Collaboration & Delivery

• Work alongside other developers, designers, and product stakeholders to deliver features end-to-end

• Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback

• Communicate progress, blockers, and technical considerations clearly to the wider team

Quality & Maintenance

• Test and debug applications to ensure a smooth, reliable user experience

• Support ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, and incremental improvements across live sites and applications

• Contribute to improving front-end tooling, workflows, and documentation over time

 

What We Are Looking For

• Solid, hands-on experience as a Front End Web Developer, building real web applications

• Strong working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, Next.js and Node.js

• Experience with Payload CMS

• Proven experience implementing Figma (or similar) designs into accurate, production-ready code

• Experience building single page applications (SPAs)

• Good understanding of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility

• Comfortable working collaboratively with designers, developers, and non-technical stakeholders

• A methodical, detail-oriented approach to writing and testing code

• Good communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven attitude

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package

  • Hybrid working model

  • Real opportunities for progression as the business scales

  • The chance to influence both customer experience and product development

  • A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

 

Equal Opportunities
1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Talent Lead
jobs.description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Lead to own and build our hiring function from scratch. You’ll personally drive hiring across the company, build scalable recruiting processes, track hiring performance, and work closely with the Head of People and hiring managers across GTM, Ops, Research, and Product.

 

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Own and run the hiring process end-to-end (sourcing, screening, interviews, and closing)

  • Personally source and hire candidates across the company (this is a hands-on recruiting role)

  • Build our hiring processes and infrastructure from scratch, including interview loops, scorecards, pipelines, and candidate tracking

  • Work closely with hiring managers to define roles, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles

  • Drive hiring across a wide range of functions, including GTM, Ops, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Lead international hiring across the US, EU, UK, and other markets as we expand

  • Build and maintain hiring metrics and reporting, including pipeline conversion, time to hire, source performance, and offer acceptance

  • Use hiring data to identify bottlenecks and continuously improve the recruiting process

  • Build and maintain strong sourcing channels across different functions and geographies

  • Develop a strong candidate experience and represent White Circle throughout the hiring process

  • Help define and improve our approach to hiring, including how we assess candidates and make hiring decisions

  • Partner with leadership on long-term talent planning and hiring strategy

 

You’ll fit right in if you:

  • Have several years of experience running hiring at a startup, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth environment

  • Have personally hired a meaningful number of people and are comfortable owning the full recruiting process yourself

  • Have built hiring processes and recruiting operations from scratch

  • Have experience hiring across multiple functions, including GTM, Operations, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Have experience with international hiring across multiple countries and markets

  • Are comfortable working directly with leadership and senior hiring managers

  • Are highly data-driven and comfortable tracking and analysing recruiting metrics

  • Are an excellent sourcer and know how to find strong candidates beyond simply posting jobs

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Are comfortable operating independently in an environment where processes are still being built

  • Speak and write fluent English (C1+)

A big plus:

  • Experience hiring for AI, ML, and Research roles

  • Experience building a recruiting function as the first or one of the first talent hires

  • Experience hiring in the US, EU, and UK

  • Experience with employer branding and building a strong talent pipeline

  • Experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, research, or recruiting ops

 

Why White Circle

  • Meaningful equity package

  • Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  • All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  • Covered subscriptions for AI agents

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Mabella

 

How we hire

  1. Introductory call with Head of People (25 min)

  2. Practical Recruitment Exercise with Head of People (60 min)

  3. Final conversation with our CEO (45 min)

Please submit your application in English.

jobs.description:
We are on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. Our green steel production in Boden will be powered by one of the world’s largest green hydrogen plants, running on renewable electricity. Instead of emitting large amounts of CO₂, as in traditional steelmaking processes, our primary emission will be water. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. The facility will impact, and shape, the surroundings as well as the perception of Boden, with the aim that it will be seen as a symbol for the much-needed green transition of heavy industry.

The Contract Manager is an active and engaged team member within the Contract Management team in support of both Project Leads, Construction Managers and other stakeholders. The role will be a direct report to the Lead Contract Manager / Head of Contracts and with a functionally to the Site Construction Manager / Area Manager.

Responsibilities

·      Manages Site Contractors in terms of contract management and administration

·      Work as part of an integrated cross-functional Site team

·      Address contractual and commercial risks and identifying and implementing mitigation measures

·      Ensure a flexibility approach whilst adhering to requirements and standards

·      Support the Project Site and Contract Management teams in defining contracting strategies

·      Support of processing and enforcement of Change Requests, Change Orders and claims

·      Participation in the reviewing and examination of contracts in support of contract negotiations

·      Coordination and alignment with other contract managers

·      Ensuring the uniform interpretation of contractual clauses and treatment of Change Requests, Change Orders, claims and implementation of lessons learned

·      Support of Project Site and Contract Management teams regarding contractual issues and correspondence (externally as well as internally)

·      Interface with other departments such as Legal, Engineering, Finance, Technical, etc.

·      Provide support on contractual issues, risk and opportunities and assistance in the identification, capture, analysis, mitigation and tracking of project risks

·      Ensuring working in compliance with policies, procedures and systems (ACC, GEP and others).

Qualifications

·      Minimum 10 years of experience as a Contract Manager on major construction projects.

·      Legal, commercial, and/or technical background with a university degree or equivalent qualification; legal and commercial expertise is preferred.

·      Open, articulate, and transparent, with clear and concise communication skills, both verbal and written.

·      Highly engaged and detail-oriented.

·      Experience from Scandinavian projects is considered an advantage.

·      Strong proficiency in Swedish, both written and spoken is considered an advantage

Job conditions

NOTE: our Talent Acquisition is based in Sweden, you will receive a phone call from a Swedish number (+46).

Why Voi?

Working at Voi is more than just a job; it's a personal Voiage where you'll grow as a professional and be part of a diverse team and culture that's committed to making a positive impact on society. In addition to this, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Join Europe's leading micromobility company and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups

  • Make a direct impact on our ongoing success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in Norway.

  • Collaborate with inspiring, motivated, and diverse colleagues who share a common goal

  • Be a part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are clean, quiet, and free from pollution

Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Since 2018, Voi has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 150,000+ vehicles in 110+ towns and cities across 12 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 400+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.

Diversity Matters

As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager – HR x AI x Business
jobs.description:
Location – Gothenburg, Sweden (Group Head Office)

Picadeli - a leading global food-tech company in healthy fast food with 2500 salad bars across Europe and the US. We offer an innovative and intelligent salad bar concept where consumers can pick and mix their own delicious, healthy and affordable salads. At Picadeli we are a group of dedicated colleagues on a mission to democratize healthy food by making it accessible, affordable and appetizing.

Our vision? A world where fast food is the opposite of junk food - and trust us, it's a mission worth joining! Read more at picadeli.se

Are you the one...?

We're looking for someone who's just as much a strategist as connector, someone who turns ideas into action and won't call an initiative done until it's fully in use. You have an international background as a senior HRBP, HRIS or similar, with a strong record of digitizing HR and putting AI to work.

You describe yourself as a perfect blend of heart and data, and a front-runner in taking HR into the future. On top of your day-to-day support to managers and employees, you'll be a close sparring partner to our CHRO, who expects you to help shape the strategy and turn it into reality. If that sounds like you, we can't wait to meet you!

Your Mission

As People Operations Manager, you'll combine daily hands-on support with strategic ownership. You'll be the go-to person who supports and guides both managers and employees, always challenging what can be streamlined with AI. Backed by a strong in-house Tech/AI team, you´ll have support just steps away!

The mission includes digitalization of manual HR processes across all our markets, continuously developing our HiBob platform to keep pace with the business. You work closely with the CHRO, from building the teams of tomorrow to developing the leaders who run them.

In Details

Shaping HR Processes & Digitalization - Digitalize and AI-enable manual HR processes across our markets (onboarding, contracts, approvals, reporting), continuously developing our HiBob platform to boost efficiency, data quality and compliance with local labor law.

People Operations - Be the go-to person on HR processes, policies, system questions, labor law and collective agreements, and own the group's onboarding program end to end.

Career Development & Skills Investment - Map future skills need, spot talent early, and initiate programs that turn potential into performance.

Employee Surveys & Engagement - Drive our employee engagement surveys end to end and support managers to turn feedback into action plans that make sense.

Compensation & Compliance - Own the annual pay equity analysis and salary review and ensure compliance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Administration & Documentation - Own yearly reporting, sick leave administration, collective agreements, the benefits portal, and make sure our guidelines keep the work environment healthy and compliant.

As our HRIS & Business Partner goes on parental leave, this role's focus may evolve during 2028, shaped by the business, your strengths, and the whole team's talent.

Your Profile

International background, ideally from a scale-up, with broad HR expertise and a genuine drive to use AI and data to change the way HR works. Strategic, data-driven decisions come naturally, and you're just as comfortable starting an initiative as driving it to the finish line.

You lead yourself with a strong inner drive, prioritize with confidence, and move fast in both thought and action. Your social intelligence builds trust at every level, your energy is contagious, and you combine relationship-building with real integrity.

You're already convinced that company culture matters, and that it shapes both people and business outcomes. It's not "an HR thing." It's everyone's responsibility. For you, it comes naturally to lead by example and guide the way.

Furthermore, you have

● Relevant academic degree

● Several years of experience in HR, with demonstrated ownership of an HRIS platform

● You've previously implemented skills development strategies

● Solid understanding of Swedish labor law but also experience from multi-country HR

● Track record of digitalizing manual routines, driving system adoption and using AI in daily HR work

● You communicate with mastery both in writing and out loud

● Fluent in both English and Swedish, written and spoken including excellent communication skills

Why Picadeli?

Join a leading global food-tech company where innovation and momentum happen every day. With clear ownership, supportive colleagues, and Picadeli´s pace of expansion give you real room to grow and make a difference. Our newly renovated Gothenburg HQ has been nominated one of Sweden's finest offices, close to public transport with parking right outside. We offer a competitive salary, private health insurance, a generous wellness allowance, and have been a certified Great Place to Work for years.

Ready to Apply?

We look forward to your application! Please send your application at the latest 2026-09-28. If you have specific questions that you feel the need to sort out before sending your application, please contact Recruit Partner’s consultant Martina Nordberg at +46 73 624 77 24 or email martina.nordberg@recruitpartner.se.

We have chosen our recruitment partners and do not wish to be contacted by recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. Department of Food Science

The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties.

We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:

  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.

  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies

  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.

  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.

  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.

In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group.

The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology.

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

jobs.title: Factotum / Agent(e) d'entretien polyvalent(e) de propriété H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
AF INVEST SARL recherche pour le Château de Conros, situé à Arpajon-sur-Cère (15130), un(e) Factotum / Agent(e) d'entretien polyvalent(e) de propriété H/F en CDI à temps complet.
Nous recherchons une personne expérimentée, autonome, fiable et polyvalente pour assurer l'entretien général du Château et de son domaine, le suivi des animaux, la maintenance courante des équipements ainsi qu'une présence attentive sur la propriété.
Vos principales missions :
Entretien du Château et des dépendances
Entretien régulier des espaces intérieurs et des dépendances.
Veille au bon état général des lieux.
Réalisation de petits travaux et réparations courantes.
Identification des dysfonctionnements et, si nécessaire, organisation de l'intervention d'un professionnel.
Entretien du parc et des extérieurs
Entretien du parc en toutes saisons.
Tonte, ramassage des feuilles et nettoyage des allées.
Arrosage et entretien des plantations.
Entretien courant des espaces verts et surveillance de l'état des arbres.
Utilisation et entretien des outils et machines de jardinage.

La charge de travail est naturellement saisonnière : les missions extérieures sont plus importantes du printemps à l'automne et plus limitées durant l'hiver.

Suivi des animaux
Nourrissage et gestion de l'eau.
Nettoyage régulier des espaces intérieurs des enclos.
Gestion des stocks de nourriture et suivi des commandes.
Surveillance de l'état général des animaux.
Contact avec le vétérinaire et suivi des soins lorsque nécessaire.

Surveillance et fonctionnement du domaine
Veiller au bon état général et à la sécurité du domaine.
Contrôler régulièrement le bon fonctionnement des équipements.
Effectuer les interventions relevant de ses compétences.
Signaler les anomalies et organiser l'intervention de professionnels lorsque nécessaire.
Assurer une présence attentive sur la propriété dans le cadre des missions confiées.

Prestataires et livraisons
Accueillir les entreprises et prestataires.
Être présent lors de certaines interventions.
Réceptionner les livraisons.
Faciliter l'accès des professionnels et assurer le suivi général des interventions.

Des déplacements occasionnels pourront être demandés, notamment pour accompagner ou récupérer les propriétaires à l'aéroport.

Profil recherché :
Nous recherchons idéalement une personne disposant d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire ou d'une expérience significative dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : factotum, gardiennage de propriété, entretien de château ou de grande propriété, maintenance générale, bricolage, espaces verts.

Vous êtes une personne autonome, soigneuse, discrète, fiable et dotée d'un excellent sens pratique. Vous savez organiser votre travail, prendre des initiatives et déterminer quand une intervention peut être réalisée vous-même ou nécessite l'intervention d'un professionnel.

Permis B obligatoire. Aucun véhicule professionnel n'est mis à disposition.

Le poste est situé dans un environnement rural et nécessite une réelle autonomie dans l'organisation quotidienne du travail.

Conditions :
CDI à temps complet, prise de poste souhaitée le 2 novembre 2026. Organisation du temps de travail adaptée à la saisonnalité des missions, dans le respect des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Des interventions ponctuelles pourront être organisées selon les besoins du domaine.

Rémunération : 2 400 € brut mensuels sur 12 mois, soit 28 800 € brut annuels, selon profil et expérience.

Avantage majeur : logement individuel indépendant mis à disposition sur le domaine, comprenant 3 chambres, salon, cuisine et jardin, ainsi qu'une place de stationnement au sein de la propriété.
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne souhaitant s'inscrire dans la durée et participer au bon fonctionnement quotidien d'une propriété de caractère.

Ylivieskan kaupungin kuntatekniikan palvelut vastaa kaupunkimme katujen, kevyen liikenteen väylien, muiden yleisten alueiden ympärivuotisesta kunnossapidosta ja viemäriverkoston toimivuudesta.
Teemme töitä pääsääntöisesti ulkona säällä kuin säällä, joten joustava asenne ja vaihteleviin olosuhteisiin sopeutuminen ovat meille tärkeitä. Meillä pääset tekemään konkreettista ja näkyvää työtä osana reipasta ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Tarjoamme monipuolisia käytännön työtehtäviä sekä vakaan ja kannustavan työyhteisön kehittyvässä kaupungissa.
Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen kunnossapidon työntekijää katujen, viemäreiden ja yleisten alueiden hoitoon sekä kunnossapitoon. Työtehtävät sisältävät tarvittaessa myös maanrakennustöitä (lapiotyöt/putkitus) työmailla. Työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa sekä ennen kaikkea joustavaa asennetta työntekoon.

Ammatillista perustutkintoa (mielellään maanrakennusalan ammattitutkinto) ja/tai kokemusta maanrakennusalalta
Oma-aloitteisuutta
Rehtiä ja reipasta asennetta työtä kohtaan
Eduksi katsotaan Tieturva 1- ja työturvallisuuskortti, traktorin ajotaito sekä tasolaserin käyttötaito. Työ vaatii liikkumista koko kaupungin alueella, joten B-ajokortti on välttämätön.

Ylivieskan kaupungilla sinua odottaa itsenäinen ja vastuullinen rooli osana tiivistä työyhteisöä. Mikäli kaikki hakukriteerit eivät täyttyneetkään, mutta koet olevasi etsimämme henkilö, niin laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!

jobs.title: Open Application: Domestic Helper Opportunity in the Capital region
jobs.description:
OPEN APPLICATION: DOMESTIC HELPER / HOUSEKEEPER – HELSINKI, ESPOO & VANTAA

Are you looking for meaningful work where you can support families in their everyday lives?

Curon Helpperi is continuously looking for experienced Domestic Helpers to join our friendly and supportive team in the Capital Region. This is an open application, which means that we may not have a suitable position available immediately. We review applications as our staffing needs change and new work opportunities become available.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Domestic Helper, you provide practical day-to-day support that helps households run smoothly and makes everyday life easier for families.

The work is varied, and your tasks depend on each clients individual needs. Your working week could include cooking, cleaning, laundry care, organizing, ironing, childcare support, or helping seniors with their everyday routines.

Your tasks may include:

* Cleaning and maintaining clients homes

* Meal planning and cooking

* Laundry care, ironing and folding clothes

* Childcare and/or support for seniors

* Light gardening and outdoor tasks

* Pet care, such as walking a dog


WORKING HOURS AND LOCATION

* Work is mainly available from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 17:30

* Occasional evening or weekend work may also be available

* The work takes place in several client homes across the Capital Region

* Most clients are located in Helsinki and Espoo, but work may also be available in Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas


WE OFFER

* Opportunities for gig work, part-time work or full-time employment, depending on our current staffing needs and your availability

* A supportive working environment and a caring team

* Training, guidance and support in your work

* An ongoing employment contract when applicable

* Salary according to the Facility Services Collective Agreement

For example, the salary for a full-time position with 100% working hours is €2,074 per month. The hourly salary is €13 per hour.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* At least two years of experience as a domestic helper or housekeeper, or at least two years of cleaning experience combined with strong cooking skills

* Ability to prepare both Western dishes and food from other cuisines

* Ability to work independently and take initiative

* Fluent English or Finnish — you must be able to communicate well in at least one of these languages

* You are already living in Finland and have the right to work in Finland

* A positive attitude, reliability and respect for clients privacy

A valid driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage but are not required.


APPLICATION PROCESS

If this type of work feels right for you, please submit an open application through the link below.

Please note that this is an ongoing open application, and we may not have a suitable position available immediately. Applications are accepted only through the application form. We will contact suitable candidates when work opportunities become available.

Thank you for your interest in working with Curon Helpperi. We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas
Start date: According to our staffing needs and the candidates availability
Application period: Ongoing

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab med høj faglighed, selvstændige konsultationer og varierede patientforløb. Vi prioriterer faglig udvikling i trygge rammer med fast supervision og mulighed for at kalde en speciallæge ved behov for sparring. Vi søger en selvstændig sygeplejerske, og er der opgaver, du ikke har erfaring med, tager vores introduktionsprogram højde for det, så du kommer godt og trygt fra start.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling i trygge rammer, med sparring fra speciallæge og sygeplejekolleger

  • Er sygeplejerske med erfaring i selvstændigt arbejde fra almen praksis, kommune eller sygehus.

  • Ønsker en stor arbejdsplads, hvor du kan blive en fast del af vores fællesskab

  • Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til klinikkens faglige udvikling

jobs.title: Boat Builder
jobs.description:
Want to shape the future of waterborne transport and join a world-class team?

Candela is the global leader in electric hydrofoil vessels. Since 2014, we’ve gone from building our first premium electric speedboat in a small Stockholm workshop to delivering game-changing vessels around the globe. The Candela P-12 is our latest innovation – the world’s first electric hydrofoil ferry is not only operating in Stockholm, but is now attracting orders from around the world.

Our boats “fly” thanks to computer-guided underwater wings under the hull made out of lightweight carbon fiber. The wings lift the vessel above the water, reducing energy use by up to 80%, while offering zero emissions and a far better passenger experience than traditional diesel vessels.

And that’s exactly why we do this. Our mission is clear: to speed up the transition to fossil fuel-free lakes and oceans.

You can now be part of the amazing team at Candela! We are looking for Boat Builders to support Candela’s future growth ambitions.

About the role

As a Boat Builder, you will play an important hands-on role in building our electric boats. We have opportunities in two different areas of production: Assembly and Composite.

Depending on your experience and profile, you may join one of these teams:

Assembly

In the Assembly area, you will help build and install the interior of our boats. Your work will mainly involve composite parts, including measuring, cutting, shaping and assembling components according to drawings and instructions.

Composite

In the Composite area, located at the beginning of the production process, you will work with carbon fiber and other composite materials. You will prepare and mix materials and ensure they are properly prepared and placed for the molding process.

Across both areas, you will work with a variety of hand tools and power tools, and be responsible for using and maintaining them safely and efficiently. Precision, attention to detail and a strong focus on quality are essential, as your work contributes directly to the quality and performance of our vessels.

Your core responsibilities will include:

    Working hands-on with the production and assembly of our electric boats
    Measuring, cutting, shaping and assembling composite components
    Working with carbon fiber and other composite materials
    Preparing and mixing composite materials for the molding process
    Assembling components according to technical drawings, instructions and specifications
    Using hand tools and power tools safely and efficiently
    Performing adjustments and ensuring proper fit, alignment and finish
    Inspecting your work to ensure it meets quality standards and specifications
    Maintaining tools, equipment and a clean and organized work environment
    Documenting work according to company procedures
    Following safety rules and using provided personal protective equipment (PPE)
    Working in an international environment – our corporate language is English, including in production

What are we looking for?

You are a practical, detail-oriented and hands-on person who enjoys building high-quality products. You have experience working with tools and are comfortable working in a production or workshop environment.

You take pride in your work and understand the importance of precision, quality and following instructions. You are eager to learn, adaptable and enjoy working as part of a collaborative and diverse team.

Experience with composite materials is valuable, but we are also interested in candidates with a strong practical background and the right mindset who are motivated to learn.

Requirements:

    Ability to communicate in English in your daily work
    Experience working safely with hand tools and power tools
    Ability to read and work according to technical drawings and instructions
    Attention to detail and a strong focus on quality
    Good physical condition and ability to work hands-on, including standing for extended periods and working in tight spaces
    Willingness to work in a production environment and follow safety procedures

Meritorious (nice to have):

    Experience from assembly or production work
    Experience working with composite materials, carbon fiber or similar materials
    Experience from the marine, automotive or other manufacturing industries
    Experience with mechanical assembly or installation
    Experience working with technical drawings
    Experience from a workshop or manufacturing environment

Form of employment: Full-time with initial 6-month probation period

Start date: ASAP

Location/base: Rotebro

Team: Assembly or Composite

Reporting to: Production Area Manager

Why people love working at Candela

At Candela, we’re not just building electric vessels – we’re creating a whole new category of clean, efficient waterborne transport. You get the chance to work with cutting-edge technology, solving complex challenges and seeing the results in action – sometimes literally, when we organize test rides for our newcomers!

We’re a diverse and ambitious team of over 50 nationalities, united by a revolutionary spirit and kindness. That means we work hard, but always with humility and while having fun – whether it’s solving a manufacturing challenge, improving processes or cheering each other on during Candela Months, our year-round calendar of bonding activities and events.

We’re office-first but not office-only. We believe collaboration is most powerful when we build together, in person – but we also trust our team to work in ways that fit their life. At Candela, you’ll find a place where bold ideas are welcomed, great people are celebrated and the ride is just as important as the destination.

Recruitment process

We aim to keep our recruitment process as straightforward and efficient as possible. As an international company with English as our corporate language, the entire process is conducted in English. Therefore, please submit your application in our corporate language as well.

Kindly note that we cannot process applications sent via email due to GDPR, so please use our career website for your application.

We welcome the opportunity to meet you!

jobs.title: Ledig graverstilling
jobs.description:
Stillingen som graver ved Tvede-Linde-Mellerup kirker er ledig til besættelse snarest, gerne 1. oktober 2026. Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge.

Den ledende graver skal varetage følgende opgaver på vore tre kirker i Tvede, Linde og Mellerup samt sognehuset og arealerne omkring præstegården i Tvede.
  • Varetage og være ansvarlig for kirkegårdenes og præstegårdsarealernes vedligeholdelse, gravfæstelser m.m.
  • Lede og fordele arbejdsopgaverne i graverteamet
  • Varetage indledende registrering af gravsteder, opdatere gravstedsbreve, legater og udskrive fakturaer
  • Udføre kirketjeneste ved kirkelige handlinger på skift og sammen med gravermedhjælper
  • Samarbejde med øvrige kirkelige myndigheder
  • Varetage periodevis rengøring af kirker og kontorer m.m.
  • Bistå præster og samarbejde med andre ansatte med løsning af diverse opgaver omkring kirkelige arrangementer

Vi forventer at du:
  • Er pligtopfyldende, effektiv og mødestabil
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også indgå i fælles opgaver og samarbejder
  • Kan tilrettelægge opgaver og administrere arbejdstiden over hele året
  • Kan håndtere diverse små maskiner, flere arbejdssteder og mangeartede opgaver
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat på kort tid til uforudsete opgaver
  • Er udadvendt og imødekommende for folk, der kommer på kirkegårdene
  • Har kørekort og kan stille bil til rådighed for kørsel mellem kirkegårdene
  • Kan medvirke ved afvikling af kirkelige handlinger
  • På alle måder har overskud til at skabe et sundt og godt miljø for graverteamet

Kirkerne har automatiske ringeanlæg.

Der er ikke krav om gartnerisk uddannelse, men det vil ses som en fordel.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og OAO-S samt organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver og det tilhørende protokollat for gravere.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for gravere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 1, hvis der ikke er gartnerisk uddannelse.
Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 342.523 kr. - 421.573 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).
Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 2, ved gartnerisk uddannelse.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 350.435 kr. - 438.259 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Der ydes rådighedstillæg efter gældende overenskomst. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 16.297 - 27.246,56 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026)
Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Pension kommer oveni efter overenskomstens bestemmelser.

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for gravere gennemføres inden for 2 år efter ansættelsens start, hvis uddannelsen ikke allerede er gennemført.

Ansættelse sker ved Tvede-Linde-Mellerup-sognes menighedsråd

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Er der spørgsmål vedr. stillingen, kan man rette henvendelse til menighedsrådsformand Laila Hjorth Fournais Clausen på tlf. 40105820

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes via ansøgningsknappen.

Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde snarest og senest 20. sept 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes af finde sted umiddelbart herefter.
