jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer @Plato (backed by Hexa)
jobs.description:
⚖️ Who are we

Plato is building the AI OS for litigation lawyers.

With AI, the legal industry is on the verge of a major transformation. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more.

Our mission: Build the leading AI OS for litigation lawyers, enabling professionals to work 5x faster, by putting their whole firm on autopilot.

Plato already supports more than 30 law firms and 1 major insurance company’s legal team, who use our solution daily to manage hundreds of active cases.

Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding.

Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals.

🎯 Your mission

You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product.

Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems.

You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Responsibilities

Build AI-powered product features

  • Design and ship AI features used directly by lawyers

  • Be at the bleeing edge of the agentic stack: memory, sandboxes, code mode, lots of tools, subagents…

  • Turn prototypes and experiments into production-ready feature

Work with complex data

  • Extract, structure and reason over large volumes of unstructured legal documents

  • Build robust data and document-processing pipelines

  • Experiment with different models and approaches to improve accuracy and reliability

Make AI work in production

  • Evaluate and improve agent outcomes through testing, evals and iteration

  • Optimize systems for quality, latency and cost

  • Build the backend services and infrastructure needed to run AI reliably at scale

Shape the product

  • Work directly with the founders and users to understand real-world problems

  • Move quickly from problem → experiment → production (think days, not weeks)

  • Take ownership of your projects from exploration to deployment

🤩 This role is for you if

We're looking for a strong software or AI engineer with 2+ years of experience who wants to build real-world AI products at the forefront of the agentic stack.

You like working close to founders and users, making pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping software that actually runs in production.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong software engineering foundation, ideally with Typescript and experience shipping production systems

  • Have experience with agents and/or evals and frameworks like Mastra, Eve, Pydantic, Langchain, etc…

  • Can take an AI problem from experimentation to production

  • Enjoy solving problems with no clear solution

  • Have a strong product mindset and care about user impact

  • Are autonomous and pragmatic, comfortable navigating early-stage ambiguity and shipping fast

⚙️ Our tech stack

Our stack is designed to support AI-first workflows and production reliability.

  • Backend & Frontend: TypeScript, Node.js, React, tRPC

  • Infrastructure: AWS (Terraform)

  • Data & AI: Mastra, Bedrock

  • Database: Postgres

You don't need to master every tool — what matters is your ability to design robust systems, learn fast, and make sound technical trade-offs.

💎 What we offer

  • Build alongside a strong AI expert: Work closely with Alexandre, our CTO, who has deep expertise in AI agents, and turn cutting-edge AI into production systems.

  • Ownership & Impact: As the second engineering hire, you'll have real influence on the product and technical direction

  • Bring AI to real users: Build production AI systems that solve real problems in a complex, high-stakes domain

  • Hexa ecosystem: Access to expertise, resources, and network from one of Europe's leading startup studios

  • Competitive package: Attractive salary + meaningful equity

  • Paris-based team: Work alongside the founding team in our office

  • Growth: Opportunity to grow into a technical leadership role as the team scales

Plato is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

We know there's a long way to go regarding diversity in our industry, which is why we encourage all applicants to apply to our open positions.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Comand AI's mission is to build next-generation C2 software with real users in real deployments in the field. We are fully indexed on the success of every single user, which means even an early concept has to make a complex operational idea clear and credible.

The BD Product Designer turns a promising customer conversation into something people can see, use, and react to quickly. This role is distinct from core product design. Core product designers go deep on durable product experiences; you help the business development team make a future capability tangible, then feed what you learn back into product.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Turn an emerging customer need into a convincing prototype in days, even when the original brief is incomplete or contradictory

  • Choose the fastest useful medium for the problem: a polished Figma prototype, an AI-assisted coded mock-up, an interactive concept, or a demo video

jobs.title: Haridustehnoloog
jobs.description:
Tähtajatu tööleping täistöökohaga

Tööülesanded: Õpetajate ja teiste haridustöötajate süsteemne toetamine ning nõustamine digitaalsete töövahendite, tarkvara ja õpikeskkondade eesmärgipärasel ja pedagoogilisel kasutamisel õppeprotsessis.
Kooli e-õppekeskkondade (Stuudium/eKool, Google Classroom või muud õppeplatvormid) haldamine, kasutajate toetamine ja funktsionaalsuse arendamine. Kooli töötajate haridustehnoloogiliste ja digitaalsete pädevuste hindamine, koolitusvajaduse kaardistamine ning asutusesiseste koolituste, seminaride ja töökodade planeerimine ja läbiviimine. Nüüdisaegse digiõppevara ja interaktiivsete õppematerjalide loomise, valideerimise, litsentseerimise ja õppetöösse juurutamise koordineerimine ning õpetajate suunamine autorõiguste järgimisele. Haridustehnoloogia-alastes arendustegevustes, projektides, uuringutes ja koostöövõrgustikes osalemine (sh riiklikul ja rahvusvahelisel tasemel). Info- ja kommunikatsioonitehnoloogia-alaste trendide, vahendite ja võimaluste seire (sh riiklikud ja rahvusvahelised arengusuunad) ning teavitus õppeasutuses uute pedagoogiliste lahenduste rakendamiseks. Organisatsiooni arengut suunavate dokumentide koostamisel osalemine (sh digiplaani koostamine ja õppekavaarendus) ning õppeasutuse esindamine digitehnoloogia-alastes küsimustes erinevates töörühmades ja partnerlussuhetes.

Omalt poolt pakume: arengule suunatud meeskonna toetust;
osalemist erinevates projektides; 56 kalendripäeva puhkust; võimalusel paindlikku tööaega õpingute ajal; vajadusel täienduskoolitusi jm arenguvõimalusi; soodsat koolilõunat; tasuta parkimist; prillitoetust; elusündmuste toetust ja stabiilset sissetulekut; vajadusel elamispinda, koolipidajaga kokkuleppel

Muud nõuded: Erialane kõrgharidus (soovitavalt haridustehnoloogia, infotehnoloogia või pedagoogika valdkonnas; või pedagoogiline kõrgharidus koos täiendava haridustehnoloogilise väljaõppega).
Eesti keele oskus kõrgtasemel (C1-tase nii kõnes kui kirjas) ning vähemalt ühe võõrkeele (soovitavalt inglise keel) oskus erialase kirjanduse ja rahvusvaheliste suundumuste jälgimiseks. Väga hea suhtlemis-, nõustamis- ja esitlusoskus, koostöövalmidus, empaatiavõime ja oskus juhendada erineva digivõimekusega täiskasvanud õppijaid (õpetajaid). Algatusvõime, analüütiline mõtlemine, projektijuhtimise algteadmised ja valmisolek meeskonnatööks ning võrgustikukoostööks.

jobs.title: Õde
jobs.description:
Tõrva kodu ootab oma meeskonda hoolivat ja pühendunud õde

Tööülesanded: Toetab erihooldusteenusel olevate inimeste tervist ja heaolu, tagades professionaalse, turvalise ja inimkeskse õendusabi.
Hindab ja jälgib klientide terviseseisundit, sealhulgas elutähtsaid näitajaid, haavade seisundit ning lamatiste tekke riski. Teostab õendustoiminguid, sh haavaravi ning osaleb terviseprobleemide ennetamises ja varajases märkamises. Hindab vaimset tervist ning viib läbi terviseedenduslikke tegevusi ja grupisekkumisi (nt unehügieeni ja rahunemistehnikate teemal). Korraldab ravimite tellimist, jälgib nende kasutamist ning tagab ravimite nõuetekohase ja ohutu hoiustamise. Korraldab vaktsineerimisi ning rakendab nakkustõrje meetmeid. Korraldab sõeluuringutes osalemist ning hindab elukeskkonna ja abivahendite vajadust. Dokumenteerib õendustegevused vastavalt kehtivatele nõuetele. Teeb koostööd erihooldusteenusel oleva inimese, tema lähedaste või eestkostja, hoolduspersonali ning pere- ja eriarstidega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Hea ja hooliv meeskond – sõbralikud kolleegid ja toetav õhkkond.
Ühised üritused – meeskonnaüritused ja traditsioonid, mis loovad ühtekuuluvustunnet. Paindlik töökorraldus – aitame töö ja eraelu paremini ühildada. Toetused eraelu oluliste sündmuste puhul – nt lapse sünni või lähedase kaotuse korral.

Muud nõuded: Oskus hinnata inimese terviseseisundit ning teostada õendustoiminguid iseseisvalt ja professionaalselt.
Kogemus või valmisolek teha koostööd perearstide, eriarstide ning teiste tervishoiu- ja sotsiaalvaldkonna spetsialistidega. Hea digipädevus ja oskus kasutada tervishoiu infosüsteeme ning teisi tehnoloogilisi lahendusi oma töös. Isikuomadused: Empaatiline ja lugupidav suhtumine erivajadustega inimestesse. Hea suhtlemis- ja koostööoskus. Korrektsus, kohusetundlikkus ja täpsus. Iseseisvus otsuste tegemisel ning vastutustunne oma töö korraldamisel. Paindlikkus ja meeskonnatöö valmidus.

jobs.title: Kogukonna noorsootöötaja
jobs.description:
Tule Kohtla-Nõmme noorte kogukonna arendajaks!

Tööülesanded: Toila Kultuuri- ja Noorsootöö Keskuse noortevaldkonna tiim otsib oma meeskonda inimest, kes soovib olla noortele usaldusväärne arengupartner, usub nende potentsiaali ning soovib koos noortega kujundada Kohtla-Nõmmel aktiivset, ettevõtlikku ja kokkuhoidvat noorte kogukonda.
Sinu peamine ülesanne on panna koostöös noorte ja partneritega alus Kohtla-Nõmme noorte kogukonnale, toetada selle järjepidevat arengut ning luua mitteformaalse õppe kaudu noortele võimalusi kujuneda aktiivseteks ja vastutustundlikeks ühiskonnaliikmeteks. Omalt poolt pakume: - võimalust kujundada Kohtla-Nõmme piirkonna noorsootööd selle uues arenguetapis ning panustada kohaliku noorte kogukonna kujunemisse;

Tööülesanded: Õpetaja ülesanne on 4-9 aastastele lastele mängulise huviringi tunni ettevalmistamine ning seeläbi inglise keele õpetamine. Õpetajale on abiks huvikooli õppekava, materjalid, koolitused ja sõbralik töökollektiiv, kellega on võimalik oma rõõme, muresid ja ideid alati arutada.
Ühe huviringi tunni pikkuseks on 40 minutit ning tunnid toimuvad lasteaedades (ja koolides) nii Haapsalus kui ka selle ümbruses. Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning algavad enamasti alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Töö paindlik graafik ning väike koormus (1-12 tundi nädalas) sobivad väga hästi kooli või teise töö kõrvalt töötamiseks. Tööülesannete hulka kuuluvad lisaks tunni ettevalmistamisele ja tunni läbiviimisele ka laste kohaloleku märkimine Google'i tabelisse ning tunni kokkuvõtte saatmine lapsevanematele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie õpetajad töötavad toetavas ja teineteist hoidvas kollektiivis, kus ükski mure ei jää lahendamata. Korraldame õppeaasta jooksul mitmeid koolitusi esile kerkivatel teemadel ning veedame niisama mõnusalt koos aega.
Õpetajal on vabadus kujundada omanäoline tund! Selleks pakume omalt poolt mahukat õppematerjalide ning -laulude kogumikku, kuid lõpuks kujundab iga õpetaja oma tunnid ise. Kui materjalidest või mõtetest jääb väheks, aitavad tunnni ettevalmistusel kaasõpetajad ja huvikooli õppejuht. Pakume osalist ning paindlikku tööaega (1-12 tundi nädalas). Tunnid toimuvad vaid nädala sees ning hakkavad tavaliselt alates kella kolmest pärastlõunal. Nii jääb aega kooli või muude tegevuste jaoks. Meie õpetajad teenivad konkureerivat töötasu. Samuti hüvitame transpordikulud nii isikliku auto kui ühistranspordiga sõites.

Tööülesanded: sõidukite iseseisev diagnostika ja rikete põhjuste väljaselgitamine;
sõidukite tehniline hooldus ja remont; vajalike remonditööde määramine; rikete kõrvaldamine ja tehtud töö kvaliteedi kontroll. Otsime autotehnikut, kes suudab iseseisvalt läbida kogu tööprotsessi: diagnoosida sõiduki, tuvastada probleemi ning teostada vajaliku remondi.

Omalt poolt pakume: tööd nii tavapärase hoolduse kui ka keerukamate tehniliste juhtumitega;
võimalust töötada ja areneda koos tehnilise spetsialistiga, kellel on autoremondi kogemus alates 1995. aastast; varustatud töökohta ja tööks vajalikke tööriistu; iseseisvust oma töös; tükipalgasüsteemi, kus töötasu sõltub tehtud normtundide arvust. jobs.title: AI Native Product Engineer
jobs.description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role:
 

Join us as a Product Engineer to build a new product within Brevo called Brevo OS.

Brevo OS is a startup inside Brevo: a team of six, a product we started from an empty repository earlier this year, and the feel of a small company within the big one. The product works, the first customer deployments are beginning, and a great deal is still undecided — so the people who join us now will shape what it becomes.
It's an AI-native operating system for small businesses: a system of agents that helps a solopreneur, a hair salon or a building contractor run their whole business — clients, contracts and signature, invoicing, their website, their inbox. Modules get added the way an ERP grows, except the whole thing is built around agents from the ground up.


Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Turn a very high level business need into something real : understand the function, define the users, the smallest useful version, the entities and their lifecycles, the permissions and constraints that matter, and what to build versus integrate
  • Decide which of our platform primitives to extend rather than reinvent, then build it, ship it, watch it in production, and improve it
  • Work across product management, frontend, backend, data modelling, infrastructure, and AI. Everyone arrived with a specialism and nobody is confined to theirs; product thinking and business analysis is part of everyone’s job
  • Build almost entirely through coding agents: Claude Code is the workflow, not a pilot running alongside it, for implementation, codebase exploration, documentation, debugging, and operations
  • Decompose problems into work an agent can actually execute, give it context without over-constraining it, and tell the difference between correct and merely plausible
  • Verify with tests and instrumentation, not vibes, and keep a large generated codebase coherent
  • Work day to day in TypeScript, Kubernetes, and agentic frameworks

    • Who you are:
  • Around 2-5 years of professional engineering experience. We care more about your slope than your years.
  • Real depth in something, and no attachment to staying there. Bring what you're genuinely strong at — the team compounds those — and expect to spend a good part of your time well outside it.
  • Coding agents already central to how you work. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, something equivalent. Not "I've generated the Unit Tests" — real delegation of substantial work, and real review of what comes back. Scepticism about generated output is a feature of this job, not a problem.
  • Evidence you've owned a problem, not just implemented a ticket — something you helped define, drove, shipped and then lived with in production. Product questions are your questions too.
  • At your best when the brief is one sentence and the plan is still moving. We're learning what this product is, so priorities change often. The mission doesn't.
  • English. We're an international team working across France and India, and English is our working language. French is not required.
    • If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

    Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several prevention, health and wellbeing services on the Welii platform.
  • A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

    • Our candidate journey:
  • Introductory TA call (30 min)
  • Interview with our VP Engineering (60 min)
  • Live Use case (2 hours)
  • Final interview with the Global VP & People Business Partner (30 min)
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win.
Financial services is a priority growth segment for Chainalysis, including banks, payments companies, fintechs, and other financial institutions. As digital assets become more connected to the financial system, these organizations face new opportunities, regulatory obligations, and financial-crime risks. This role makes the value of Chainalysis clear to the leaders responsible for navigating them.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Financial Services, you will own how Chainalysis shows up in the market for these buyers. You will own and shape our intelligence, data, products, AI capabilities, and services into a differentiated customer story—one that connects to real workflows, urgent problems, and business outcomes.

This is a role for a strong marketer and an exceptional writer. You can take a complex capability, a shifting market, or a fuzzy customer problem and shape it into a sharp point of view, a persuasive narrative, and practical tools that sellers and customers actually use. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing & Communications, subject-matter experts, and GTM Solutions & Readiness teams to make the story land in the market.

What you’ll be doing

Position the value

  • Define and evolve the financial services value narrative: what Chainalysis enables, why it matters, and why we are meaningfully different.

  • Build messaging for priority buyer and user personas across compliance, risk, anti-fraud, investigations, and business leadership.

  • Create the narratives, proof points, and strategic assets that help sellers communicate differentiated value with conviction.

  • Own financial-services competitive intelligence, translating market moves into clear offensive and defensive positioning for deal teams.

Turn value into solutions

  • Partner with Product, R&D, Marketing & Communications, and subject-matter experts to translate innovation into compelling industry solutions, use cases, and sales plays.

  • Lead go-to-market planning for launches, major releases, platform capabilities, and commercial offerings.

  • Shape customer-facing value narratives for pricing, packaging, and commercial models, including business cases and ROI stories.

  • Bring a customer lens to product and market decisions: explain not only what a capability does, but why a Chief Compliance Officer or Head of Financial Crime should care.

Win and learn in market

  • Produce the strategic content that moves financial-services opportunities forward: first-call decks, solution briefs, talk tracks, discovery frameworks, proof points, and sales plays.

  • Partner with GTM Solutions & Readiness to scale the strongest narratives into field tools and enablement.

  • Bring customer, field, partner, and competitive insight back into the work — sharpening positioning, converting market evidence into credible stories, and building repeatable use cases.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5–8 years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing, with experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or related regulated industry.

  • A demonstrated ability to build positioning and messaging that changes how customers and sellers see a problem—not simply content that fills a library.

  • Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys and sales motions in regulated, risk-sensitive environments.

  • The ability to connect technical capabilities to business and operational value for both executive buyers and hands-on users.

  • A collaborative self-starter, comfortable working across R&D, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders to drive ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward independently.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.

  • Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.

  • Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

  • Experience marketing to financial institutions at a data, intelligence, security, or enterprise-software company.

You’ll thrive here if:
You can shape complexity into a story people remember and a sales conversation people can use. You write with precision, bring sound judgment to ambiguous problems, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Your Mission

Your mission is to bring the right small businesses to Credit Compass - those who find genuine value in the product and come back to use it regularly. We’re looking for an Acquisition Lead to join our Credit Compass team. This is a London-based role and requires at least one day a week in the office.

We already have paid channels working well on Meta, Google and TikTok, so you won't be starting from scratch. Your job is to scale what's working, launch new channels from the ground up, and run a structured experimentation programme across paid, owned and partner channels. Together, these help us learn which audiences, messages and journeys find the businesses Credit Compass can help most.

The team is made up of 8 people across design, analytics, product and tech, you’ll report into the Credit Compass Lead. You’ll lead the acquisition function with scope to hire an additional team member in the short term. Working closely with product and data, you'll turn early signals into clear insights: who Credit Compass is for, the problem it solves best and how to reach those businesses efficiently. If it goes well, you'll build a growth engine with a clear path from 10,000 to 100,000 users within a year.

Responsibilities

Your key areas of responsibility will include:

  • Scale our existing paid channels. Meta, Google and TikTok are already working - take them further by testing new audiences, creative and landing pages, and pushing efficient growth.

  • Launch new channels from scratch, across paid search and social, referrals, affiliates and partner distribution, with a focus on learning what scales and what doesn't.

  • Define the right customer segments for Credit Compass, designing and running experiments that reveal which businesses find long-term value and come back regularly.

  • Connect the right message to the right audience, writing and testing ad and landing-page copy, validating our messaging matrix and iterating based on real customer behaviour.

  • Improve conversion from existing demand, testing ways to turn low-performing organic pages and existing iwoca traffic into engaged Credit Compass users.

  • Build a test-and-learn growth engine: set clear hypotheses, run A/B tests, analyse results and turn insights into repeatable acquisition strategies.

  • Work closely with retention teams to feed learnings back into the product and help shape how Credit Compass evolves.

  • Experimentation experience, including designing A/B tests, interpreting results, and making decisions in the presence of noisy or imperfect data.

We expect to pay from £60,000 - £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

As a Data Scientist in the Direct Acquisition team, you'll design experiments and build the statistical models that shape how iwoca reaches its next customers. Your findings feed directly into how we invest in sales and marketing.

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Mistral, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they achieve their goals using Mistral’s solutions. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success. 

This role is ideal for those who excel in customer-facing environments, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are passionate about turning customer success into business impact.

What You Will Do

Customer Success Ownership

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they maximize the value of Mistral’s AI solutions.

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their business objectives and tailoring solutions to meet their needs.

  • Lead customer onboarding, adoption, and ongoing engagement to drive product usage and satisfaction.

  • Monitor customer health metrics, identify risks, and proactively address challenges to prevent churn.

  • Collaborate with Sales to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs and usage patterns.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to gather customer feedback and influence the product roadmap.

  • Develop and deliver customer training, enablement programs, and best practices to drive adoption.

  • Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) to align on goals, challenges, and success metrics.

Strategic Customer Guidance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding them on how to leverage Mistral’s AI solutions to achieve their business outcomes.

  • Work closely with Support and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, from deployment to production.

  • Create and execute customer success plans with clear KPIs, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Advocate for customer needs internally, ensuring their voice is heard in product and strategic discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer insights with Product, Sales, and Engineering teams to inform product improvements and strategic initiatives.

  • Clear obstacles for customers during deployment and adoption phases, accelerating time-to-value.

  • Support renewal processes, including contract negotiations, expansion discussions, and coordination with internal teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Account Management, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical or SaaS environment.

  • Proven ability to manage enterprise customer relationships, with a focus on driving adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

  • Experience working with technical products, with the ability to engage confidently with Data, IT, and Engineering teams.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for technical and executive audiences.

  • Business acumen: Ability to identify upsell and expansion opportunities while ensuring customer success.

  • Technical aptitude: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts is a plus; ability to understand and discuss technical requirements is essential.

  • Hands-on, customer-centric, collaborative, and organized, with a passion for solving complex challenges.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.title: Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.
jobs.description:
Starting in September 2026, we are looking for a long-term employee for the position of Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE COMPANY

During the summer season, we operate an outdoor activity base offering rafting, canyoning and mountain carts. In summer 2026, we welcomed 3,621 guests. The summer season runs from mid-May to mid-September.

During the winter season, we operate a small ski centre with the longest toboggan run in Norway and a ski rental service. In winter 2026, we welcomed 4,774 guests. The winter season runs from mid-December to mid-April.

During both seasons, guests can stay in our apartment or lavvo camp (maximum capacity of 49 people), and enjoy the facilities (sauna, hot tub, party lavvo and gas grill).

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Management of the employee team:

    • Summer season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), guide team for rafting, canyoning and mountain carts, head guide (responsible for the operation of activities), drivers and maintenance -- approximately 15 people in total

    • Winter season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), ski lift operators, snow groomer and maintenance -- approximately 5 people in total

  • Manual and administrative management, development and maintenance of the base

  • Practical day-to-day operation of the base and its activities

  • Administration and preparation of materials for accounting

  • Management of company assets (buildings, vehicles and activity equipment)

  • Cooperation with the Finance Director, Booking and Marketing departments

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

Start: September 2026

Location: Dagali Fjellpark, Perstulvegen 100, 3588 Dagali, Norway

Working hours & remuneration

  • Number of working days during the winter season (mid-December -- mid-April): approximately 101

  • Number of working days during the summer season (mid-May -- mid-September): approximately 107

  • To be adjusted according to the candidate's abilities and mutual agreement.

Compensation: approximately NOK 220/hour, or alternatively a fixed salary based on the expected number of working hours, subject to agreement.

In the case of a long-term cooperation (after the trial period and with the agreement of both parties), we can discuss a fixed salary and performance-based bonus.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Management skills

  • Assertive attitude and advanced communication skills

  • Experience working in tourism

  • Positive attitude towards outdoor activities

  • Good knowledge of English

  • Willingness to stay in Dagali (Geilo) long-term and continuously from mid-December to mid-April and from mid-May to mid-September

  • Good computer skills and ability to handle administrative tasks

  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions when necessary (snow, frost, wind, rain)

  • Responsibility, independence and attention to detail

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Long-term cooperation

  • Varied and interesting work

  • Working in the mountains and in a natural environment

  • Opportunity to participate in the development of the company

  • Benefits:

    • Free accommodation at the workplace during the first season; accommodation for future seasons by agreement.

    • Assistance with obtaining an ID number and tax card

    • Free rental of winter equipment for personal leisure activities

    • Free participation in our activities, subject to availability.

Dagali Fjellpark is a professional outdoor center that offers summer activities (rafting, canyoning, mountain carts) and winter activities (ski center, toboggan run). The place has accommodation for about 40 people, and a small cafe.

We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


As a Senior Compensation & Benefits Partner at Qonto, you will play a key role in making our compensation decisions fair, competitive and scalable.

Your mission will be twofold: act as a trusted partner on sensitive compensation decisions and build the frameworks that will support Qonto’s long-term growth.

You will work closely with Jean-Raphaël Demol, your future manager.

As a Senior Compensation & Benefits Manager at Qonto, you will

  • Partner with the business by advising Talent Acquisition, People Partners and managers with benchmarks and guidance on hiring offers, promotions, retention cases and off-cycle reviews.
  • Turn complex compensation and Benefits questions into clear recommendations, combining business context, internal equity, market data and long-term consistency.
  • Own key compensation processes & cycles: policy updates, salary review cycles and compliance monitoring and contribute to projects end-to-end.
  • Build scalable frameworks across global grading, leveling, salary ranges and pay transparency.
  • Strengthen compensation governance by improving decision rules, data quality and self-service resources in collaboration with People, Finance, Legal and HRIS teams.

What you can expect

  • Have a direct impact on hiring, retention, internal equity and the employee experience.
  • Combine business partnering with the opportunity to build frameworks that will scale across Qonto.
  • Work closely with Jean-Raphaël Demol, with growing exposure to more strategic topics as you build track record.
  • Take ownership of complex, highly visible topics rather than operating as a data provider or process administrator.
  • Operate within an experienced, international and AI-first environment where strong judgment matters as much as technical expertise.

About You

  • Experience: You have a solid experience in Compensation & Benefits and have personally owned several end-to-end compensation review cycles. You managed benefits renewal for European countries.
  • Compensation expertise: You are confident working across salary ranges, leveling, off-cycle reviews, promotions, retention and pay-transparency topics.
  • Business Partner: You identify the real business problem, use market data with judgment and provide clear recommendations rather than simply sharing benchmarks.
  • Stakeholder management: You can challenge senior stakeholders constructively, explain trade-offs and build alignment.
  • Ownership: You take initiative and drive complex topics on your own, from identifying the problem to implementing solutions, in a fast‑moving environment.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Worked in tech, fintech or another fast-scaling international environment.
  • Contributed to multi-country compensation projects.
  • Experience with Comptryx, Radford, Figures, Pave or another modern compensation platform.
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - AI Marketplace
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. You will work directly with the Director of Marketplace to take the platform from MVP to the system behind dozens of partner solutions, on a small team where you own features end-to-end and ship weekly.

About this role:
  • Build the Marketplace storefront, partner portal, and admin tooling.
  • Design and implement the APIs and services behind them: catalog, onboarding, entitlements, and metering.
  • Integrate with our mission platform for authentication, workflow triggers, and solution deployment in close collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Build connectors for third-party constellations and data providers.
  • Own quality: tests, CI/CD, monitoring.

Must Haves:
  • 4+ years building and shipping full-stack products.
  • Experience with Sprint development.
  • Strong TypeScript/React on the front end and solid backend experience in Python, Go, or Node.
  • Cloud-native by default (we run on GCP): containers/kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure as code.
  • Comfortable with API design, OAuth, and multi-tenant authorization.
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development workflows and expected to use them.
  • You have shipped a zero-to-one product, ideally a marketplace, developer platform, or SaaS portal, and you like small teams with large scope.

Nice to Haves:
  • Billing integrations (Stripe or similar).
  • Geospatial or earth observation exposure.
  • Security-minded engineering (tenant isolation, audit trails).
  • Experience in the architecture of modern systems.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

jobs.title: Hemstädare / Home cleaner - Hemfrid Landskrona
jobs.description:
We are looking for new home cleaners in Landskrona. Are you our next star? 🌟

Your profile

We love making our customers’ everyday lives easier – and so should you. We are looking for someone who likes to work independently and is driven by quality and customer service. You are punctual and responsible, with an eye for details and a positive attitude.

About the role

As a home cleaner at Hemfrid, you are responsible for cleaning our customers’ homes to the highest quality. Your mission is always to provide the best service possible. You work independently and are responsible for your clients’ satisfaction.

Your work tasks include, among others:

    

Vacuuming and dusting.

    

Mopping floors and cleaning surfaces.

    

Strengthening, folding, and washing clothes.

    

Changing bedsheets and making the bed.

    

Give the customer’s home that little extra touch.

You should:

    

Have previous experience from a service profession.

    

Speak and understand basic Swedish or English.

    

Be able to work flexible hours, Monday – Friday, between 8 – 17.

It is a strong merit if you have worked as a home cleaner, housekeeper, or equivalent before. It's also advantageous if you have a valid B driving license.

    

We offer

Our goal is clear – we want to be the best employer in the industry. We believe our employees are the heart of the company, and we are dedicated to providing good working conditions.

Among others, we offer:

    

Fixed salary every month

    

A permanent position with a 50-75 % employment rate.

    

Collective agreement and favorable terms of employment.

    

Liability insurance, health insurance, and pension insurance.

    

Wellness allowance.

    

Training in home cleaning, with a focus on your development.

    

Great career opportunities and growth within Hemfrid.

    

Free mobile subscription.

    

One of Sweden’s greatest teams of colleagues from all over the world. 🙌

About Hemfrid

Hemfrid is Sweden's leading provider of home services. We help our customers with cleaning, laundry, ironing, moving, gardening, and more. By working as a team and providing easy access to first-class home services, we unlock people's quality of life.

Our process

After completing the application, you will be contacted by the HR department regarding the recruitment process for your application.

As part of our recruitment process, we always do a background check. You need to have a Swedish personal number or a coordination number to be eligible for this position.

Are you ready to unlock people's quality of life? Great! So are we. We look forward to your application.

Welcome to Hemfrid!

Vi letar efter nya hemstädare till Landskrona. Är du vår nästa stjärna? 🌟

Din profil

Vi älskar att göra våra kunders vardag enklare – det borde du också göra. Vi söker efter någon som tycker om att arbeta självständigt och som drivs av kvalitet och kundservice. Du är punktlig och ansvarstagande, med ett öga för detaljer och en positiv inställning.

Om rollen

Som hemstädare på Hemfrid ansvarar du för att städa våra kunders hem med högsta kvalitet. Ditt uppdrag är att alltid erbjuda bästa möjliga service. Du arbetar självständigt och är ansvarig för att säkerställa att dina kunder är nöjda.

Dina arbetsuppgifter består bland annat av:

    

Dammsugning och dammtorkning.

    

Moppning och rengöring av ytor.

    

Strykning, vikning och tvätta kläder.

    

Byta lakan och bädda.

    

Ge det där lilla extra till kundens hem.

Du bör:

    

Ha tidigare erfarenhet från ett serviceyrke.

    

Tala och förstå grundläggande svenska eller engelska.

    

Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar, måndag – fredag, mellan 8 – 17.

Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska. Även meriterande om du har ett giltigt B-körkort.

Vi erbjuder

Vårt mål är tydligt – vi vill vara branschens bästa arbetsgivare. Vi tror att våra anställda är företagets hjärta, och vi är dedikerade till att erbjuda bra arbetsförhållanden.

Bland annat erbjuder vi:

    

Samma fasta lön varje månad

    

En tillsvidareanställning med 50- 75 % sysselsättningsgrad.

    

Kollektivavtal och bra anställningsvillkor

    

Ansvarsförsäkring, sjukförsäkring och pensionsförsäkring.

    

Friskvårdsbidrag.

    

Utbildning inom hemstädning, med fokus på din utveckling.

    

Goda möjligheter att utvecklas och växa inom Hemfrid.

    

Gratis mobilabonnemang.

    

Ett av Sveriges härligaste team med kollegor från hela världen. 🙌

    

Om Hemfrid

Hemfrid är Sveriges ledande aktör för tjänster i hemmet. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, tvätt, strykning, flytt, trädgårdsarbete och mycket mer. Genom att arbeta som ett team och ge våra kunder enkel tillgång till våra toppklassiga tjänster förbättrar vi deras livskvalitet.

Vår process

Efter genomförd ansökan kommer du att bli kontaktad av HR- avdelningen angående rekryteringsprocessen för din ansökan.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller. För att vara kvalificerad för den här tjänsten behöver du ha ett svenskt personnummer eller ett samordningsnummer.

Är du redo att förbättra människors livskvalitet? Bra! Det är vi också. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Välkommen till Hemfrid!

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Job Description

Checkout.com is seeking an Specialist, Deal Analyst to join our growing Sales Operations team in our London office to support our global growth. This role sits within our Commercial department.

We are looking for someone who is highly motivated, detail-oriented and confident in collaborating cross-functionally with internal teams throughout the organisation. Within this role, you will be working with teams such as Sales, Legal, Risk, Onboarding and Finance. We are looking for someone who can build for scale - a strong interest in improving and streamlining processes, and a comfort with AI and its possibilities here is vital.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter that is able to work autonomously and thrives in an entrepreneurial environment in which they can exceed expectations through personal drive.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Support and adapt the execution of new processes with a focus on pace and customer experience

  • Provide proactive support and guidance to the sales team and our merchants to complete the onboarding process.

  • Be a creative problem solver who finds a way to meet clients’ needs while adhering to Checkout.com’s policies.

  • Respond to inbound requests from the Sales team regarding onboarding or reviewing existing clients’ profiles.

  • Ensure processes which mean we have accurate and up-to-date documentation related to deal structures and contracts.

  • Create and review customer agreements/contracts

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with internal stakeholders, especially sales, Customer Onboarding, and Legal teams.

  • Manage multiple internal stakeholders while delivering exceptional service

  • Support with the onboarding of new colleagues

  • Based on the above, create impact through projects improving these processes


Qualifications

  • Very detailed oriented

  • Comfort with AI

  • Fluent English

  • Excellent customer service, customer-facing, and problem-solving skills

  • Self-starter who can work independently with minimal supervision

  • Fast learner and motivated by new challenges

  • Humble and hungry to learn

  • Able to work under pressure, multi-task, and consistently meet tight deadlines

  • Superb communication skills, ability to interact with multidisciplinary senior stakeholders

  • Familiarity with the payment processing industry and regulations is a plus

  • Experience using Salesforce a plus

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Acquiring is a foundational pillar at Checkout.com. It powers how merchants accept payments and includes the Dashboard experiences that help them understand and manage payment performance. The team also creates reusable patterns and platform capabilities that help other product teams integrate into a consistent Dashboard experience. You’ll join a Design organisation of more than 30 specialists across Product Design, Research, Content, and Technical Writing.

The role

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll bring strong interaction and visual design craft to complex B2B software. You’ll work at the centre of the Acquiring Dashboard, shaping the foundations that connect products across Checkout and make payment data easier to understand and act on. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, established foundations to build on, and the opportunity to help level up the experience as we expand into mobile-first products.

What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end design for complex Dashboard experiences in Acquiring, from early concepts through to shipped product, partnering closely with Product and Engineering.

  • Design scalable wrappers, patterns, and platform foundations that help teams across Checkout integrate experiences into the central Dashboard.

  • Lead design for payment analytics, charting, and core payment pages, translating complex payment information into clear, useful actions.

  • Shape platform-wide AI-assisted and conversational experiences, while contributing to the evolution of mobile-first experiences.

What success looks like

  • Acquiring Dashboard experiences, including payment pages and analytics, ship with clear flows, strong usability, and a consistently high level of interaction and visual craft.

  • Reusable patterns and platform foundations help other product teams deliver coherent experiences across Dashboard.

  • Your work helps establish the next generation of Acquiring experiences across desktop, mobile, and AI-enabled product surfaces.

What you’ll bring

  • A portfolio showing shipped, complex desktop web experiences in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, or another regulated product environment.

  • Strong interaction and visual design craft, from information architecture and user flows through to polished interfaces and prototypes.

  • A track record of owning complex features end to end, making clear decisions, and staying accountable for outcomes.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative product development environment.

  • Active curiosity about AI, with evidence of using AI tools in your day-to-day design workflow.

  • Confidence working with established design systems and reusable patterns, and extending them to solve new product problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing data-dense dashboards, charts, analytics, or other data visualisation experiences.

  • Experience designing mobile product interfaces.

  • Experience with merchant-facing payment products or operational tools in a regulated environment.

jobs.title: Strategist, Agent Development (Norwegian speaking)
jobs.description:
About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 

What you'll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Own the Agent Development Life Cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you'll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Compensation: £150K – £245K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: CLEANER
jobs.description:
**About the position**

Safai Cleaning Services is looking for a reliable and motivated Cleaner to perform cleaning and facility service duties at our customer locations.

The work includes maintaining clean, safe, and hygienic premises in accordance with the employers instructions and customer requirements.

**Main duties**

The Cleaners duties may include:

- Perform a variety of cleaning duties (including nursing home, Airbnb, residential, and regular cleaning).

- Regular cleaning and maintenance of customer premises

- Cleaning floors, surfaces, sanitary facilities and common areas

- Vacuuming, mopping and dusting

- Waste collection and disposal according to workplace instructions

- Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene standards

- Using cleaning equipment and materials safely

- Following employer instructions and work schedules

- Following occupational safety regulations

- Following customer-site rules and security instructions


**Requirements**

We are looking for a person who:

- Previous working experience in cleaning filed at Finland

- Due to work location the driving license is must

- Working with elderly required criminal certificate

- Is reliable, responsible and punctual

- Is able to work independently

- Has good attention to cleanliness and quality

- Is physically able to perform cleaning duties

- Is willing to work at different customer locations when required

- Follows occupational safety and workplace instructions

- Has a professional attitude towards customers and colleagues


Previous experience in cleaning or facility services is considered an advantage.

**Working hours**

Working hours are scheduled according to operational and customer needs and in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

The position involves an average working time arrangement of 8 hours per week.

Depending on work requirements and the applicable collective agreement, work may include:

- Additional working hours

- Weekdays, Night and Sunday work

- Other scheduled shifts in accordance with the agreement


**Salary and benefits**

Salary and applicable supplements are paid in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Facility Services Sector (Kiinteistöpalveluala TES).

The applicable hourly wage at the commencement of employment is €12.26 per hour, or the valid TES minimum wage applicable at the time of payment.

Applicable supplements, such as evening, night, Sunday and overtime compensation, are paid according to the collective agreement.

The work is performed primarily at Safai Cleaning Services customer locations in the Pirkanmaa region. Work may also be assigned to other customer locations in Finland when reasonably required by the employers business operations.
