jobs.title: Commercial Building Estimator
jobs.description:
For more than 60 years, Complex Co. has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


As our commercial building pipeline continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Commercial Building Estimator to play a key role in shaping successful tenders, strengthening estimating capability, and supporting the continued expansion of our commercial building arm.


This role will be responsible for delivering accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for commercial building & construction projects, while also providing day-to-day technical advice and mentoring to the estimating team.


This is a hands-on, influential role for someone who brings strong technical estimating expertise, sound commercial judgement, and the confidence to lead pricing activity across commercial building and construction opportunities.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for commercial building and construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Estimators
  • Act as first point of escalation for estimating queries and technical issues
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers


About you

  • Minimum 8+ years' experience in commercial building and construction estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex commercial building tenders
  • Strong understanding of construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills


If this sounds like the role for you please apply or reach out to Ebony Ison, ebony.ison@complexco.com.au

jobs.title: Wireperson
jobs.description:
Description Trant Te-Tech design, custom build and install a wide range of high quality control panels, motor control centres (MCCs) and automation systems, offering conventional, intelligent and withdrawable systems with outstanding reliability and functionality.
We are currently looking for a proven Wireperson to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton.

The Role The Wire Person is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing.What Youll Be DoingTechnical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring
  • Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling.
  • Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels.
  • Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements.
Technical Support & Collaboration
  • Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings.
  • Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes.
  • Follow work instructions and build documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets.
  • Support improvements in wiring practices, layout, and efficiency.
  • Provide feedback to supervisors on build issues or potential improvements.
SHE&Q and Compliance
  • Carry out self-checks and peer checks prior to formal testing.
  • Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies.
  • Work safely in accordance with company H&S procedures and UK legislation.
  • Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area.
  • Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times.
Key Interfaces:
Internal Interfaces
  • Workshop Supervisor.
  • Production Manager.
  • Test Engineer.
  • Design & Engineering Teams.
  • Automation Team.
  • Stores / Logistic.
  • Quality Team.
External Interfaces
  • Clients / Inspectors (as required)
  • Suppliers (limited)
Core Values

Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability.

What Were Looking ForEssential
  • NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings.
  • Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements.
  • Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes.
  • Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies.
  • Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring.
  • Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs.
  • Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment.
  • Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role.
Desirable
  • 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification.
  • Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021.
  • Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems.
  • First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification.
  • Experience wiring MCCs and control panels.
  • Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation.
  • Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults.
  • Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds.
Why Join Trant ?At Trant Engineering, we deliver complex, high-value engineering and construction projects across the UK. From process and water treatment to energy infrastructure upgrades, we play a key role in delivering and protecting critical national infrastructure shaping the systems that communities and industries rely on every day.

Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful.

Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential.

Whether youre starting out or looking to take your next career step, Trant offers the chance to develop, progress and make a real difference.

Our company benefits package includes:
  • Competitive rates.
  • 28 days holiday (including bank holidays).
  • Options to buy additional holiday via salary sacrifice.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Employee assistance program.
  • Discretionary annual bonus.
Join us and be part of something bigger.

jobs.title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
jobs.description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

jobs.title: PRIPRAVNIK/PRIPRAVNICA KNJIGOVOĐA/KNJIGOVOTKINJA
jobs.description:
Brandom priča je započela prije 20 godina, početkom suradnje dvoje zaljubljenika u poreze, reviziju i knjigovodstvo Branke Topolovec i Domagoja Hladike. Konkretno i objektivno pružamo kompletnu uslugu s područja knjigovodstva, poreznog savjetovanja, obračuna plaća i revizije. Subjektivni pogled i iskustvo svakako donosi najvažniju stranu poslovanja, a to je briga o našim klijentima i individualan pristup svakom zadatku. Naši klijenti su uglavnom hrvatska društva sa stranim vlasništvom. Podrška koju pružamo odnosi se na cjelokupni proces – od osnivanja društva do usluga korištenja poslovne adrese i ureda. Zbog povećanja obujma poslova proširujemo odjel i tražimo dvije osobe koje će nam se pridružiti na radnom mjestu Pripravnik knjigovođa. Pogledajte uvjete natječaja i prijavite se! Veselimo se pojačanju u našem timu. Opis poslova:
  • administrativna i operativna podrška mentoru knjigovođi
  • obavljanje knjiženja ulaznih/izlaznih računa i bankovnih izvoda, usklađenja knjigovodstvene dokumentacije
  • arhiviranje dokumentacije, predaja mjesečnih, kvartalnih i godišnjih izvještaja financijskim institucijama
  • svi ostali knjigovodstveno - računovodstveni poslovi
Uvjeti:
  • stručna sprema - SSS
  • poznavanje rada u MS Office
  • pouzdanost, komunikativnost, odgovornost
  • organizacijske sposobnosti i siguran profesionalni pristup
Nudimo:
  • ugovor na neodređeno s probnim rokom od 6 mjeseci
  • profesionalna usavršavanja i razvoj individualnih kompetencija
  • stimulativna primanja.
Naši stručnjaci oslanjaju se na sveobuhvatno znanje i širinu iskustva dobivenu iz rada s različitim industrijama. Jasno možemo razaznati karakteristike različitih klijenata i tako objektivno pristupiti svakom od njih. Želite li da vaša karijera raste i razvija se uz podršku profesionalaca s dugogodišnjim iskustvom nemojte dvoumiti. Prijavite se!

jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

Kako se prijaviti?

Ako prepoznaješ sebe u ovom opisu i želiš postati dio našeg tima, pošalji nam svoj životopis (CV) i kratko motivacijsko pismo na e-mail adresu: ldcagro1@gmail.com s naslovom "Prijava za posao: Sistem inženjer".

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes.

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

jobs.description:
První kontakt e-mailem.

Pro naši centrálu v Brně-Králově Poli hledáme šikovného grafika nebo grafičku, který/á má cit pro vizuál, dobré nápady a hlavně je umí převést do reality.
Co ti můžeme nabídnout
o    zajímavou a různorodou práci s velkým prostorem pro vlastní nápady a seberealizaci
o    nástupní mzdu od 37 100 Kč, po zapracování zapojení do našeho systému bonusů a odměn - výsledné finanční ohodnocení tak můžeš ovlivnit svojí prací a výsledky
o    příjemné pracovní prostředí v Brně-Králově Poli v nové klimatizované budově
o    fajn kolegy a šéfa, se kterým se dá normálně domluvit
o    zázemí stabilní české společnosti s historií více než 20 let
o    MultiSport kartu, slevy na firemní produkty a servis telefonů, neomezený zaměstnanecký tarif s internetem zcela zdarma
o    pracovní dobu od pondělí do pátku od 8:00 do 16:45, případně dle dohody
o    dobrou kávu na pracovišti zdarma
o    možnost nástupu ihned nebo dle dohody
Co bude náplní tvojí práce
o    péče o jednotný vizuální styl naší firmy a jeho další rozvoj
o    tvorba reklamních bannerů, kampaní a další grafiky pro náš web a e-shop
o    návrhy grafiky pro prodejny, výlohy, vitríny, prodejní pulty, plakáty, billboardy i firemní auta
o    příprava grafických podkladů pro tisk a další výrobu
o    produktové focení telefonů, příslušenství a dalšího sortimentu pro náš e-shop
o    úprava a retuš produktových fotografií
o    pravidelná kontrola vizuální podoby našich brněnských prodejen a hledání možností, jak jejich vzhled dál zlepšovat
o    realizace polepů a reklamní grafiky přímo na prodejnách - od návrhu až po finální instalaci
o    spolupráce s kolegy napříč firmou při přípravě akcí, kampaní a dalších projektů
Co od tebe očekáváme
o    cit pro grafiku, detail a jednotný vizuální styl
o    dobré nápady a schopnost dotáhnout je od prvního návrhu až po výsledek
o    samostatnost, pečlivost a zodpovědnost za odvedenou práci
o    znalost CorelDRAW, Adobe Photoshop a Adobe Lightroom
o    schopnost nafotit produkty tak, aby na našem e-shopu vypadaly atraktivně
o    praktickou zručnost - samolepicí grafiku na výlohu zvládneš nejen navrhnout, ale také správně aplikovat
o    chuť přicházet s vlastními nápady a říct, když vidíš něco, co by šlo udělat lépe
o    spolehlivost a schopnost pracovat samostatně
o    řidičský průkaz skupiny B

Zaujali jsme tě?
Pošli nám svůj životopis s fotografií, krátký průvodní dopis, proč tě tahle práce zaujala, a hlavně několik ukázek své práce nebo odkaz na portfolio na email prace@mobilprovas.cz
Nemusíš nám posílat desítky projektů. Raději vyber pár věcí, na kterých je dobře vidět, co umíš a jakým způsobem přemýšlíš nad grafikou.
Pokud nás tvůj profil a práce zaujmou, ozveme se ti telefonicky a následně tě pozveme na osobní pohovor.

multisport karta, zaměstnanecké slevy, neomezený zaměstnanecký tarif s internetem ZDARMA

jobs.title: Residential Valuer
jobs.description:
Introduction:

About The Company

Acumentis is Australia's only independent ASX-listed property valuation and advisory firm. With 350+ team members across 45 locations, we combine national scale with local support and a strong focus on service, inclusion and professional development.

Description:

About The Role

As a Residential Valuer, you will be a key member of our team, collaborating with fellow Valuers and Directors to achieve Acumentis' business objectives and regional goals. Your responsibilities will include:

  • High-Quality Valuations: Deliver valuations of the highest quality, adhering to client and company guidelines, and meeting required service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Market Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of sales trends and market conditions to inform valuation practices.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, contributing to business development initiatives.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Report regularly to the Regional Director and work closely to achieve targeted outcomes.


This position is also open to an Associate Director or Director role for the right candidate.

Skills and Experiences:

About You

Youâll be a great fit for us if:

  • You have a minimum 2 year's relevant experience in residential valuations
  • You possess tertiary qualifications in a relevant Property Degree
  • You have a Certified Practising Valuer (CPV) Qualification
  • You have strong working knowledge of the residential property market in Port Macquarie and surrounding areas.
  • You have a great ability to create and maintain working relationships with clients and colleagues


Weâll be a great fit for you if:

  • Youâd like an extra day of leave for your birthday, study or volunteer opportunities
  • Youâd like to take advantage of employee benefits such as bank partnerships, employee discounts and a full wellness calendar of activities - with new benefits added each month!
  • Youâre looking to join a business with a strong national presence, where relocation can be supported
  • Youâd like a position with a strong client base and steady stream of work
  • Youâd like to ensure your life/work balance through flexible work arrangements
  • Youâd like mentoring from industry leaders to guide your career, and create a guaranteed pathway for our twice-yearly promotion program


It is a condition of employment that staff are to obtain National Police Clearance (paid for by the business).

How To Apply

If working with Acumentis in this period of growth sounds like something you are looking for, please apply online via the link provided. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact the People Team (people@acumentis.com.au). We are unable to consider emailed applications.

Acumentis embraces and values the diversity of culture, working arrangements, sexual orientation and gender identity to ensure our workforce is representative of the community that we work within. We promote a workplace that actively seeks to include and welcome the unique contributions of all people. We embrace and celebrate the value of Indigenous people, their skills and their contribution to our organisation.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist - Island of Ireland (Restaurator/in im Steinmetz- und Steinbildhauerhandwerk/Master Professional für Restaurierung im Handwerk)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

This role requires residence in the Repub

jobs.title: Support Systems Lead (NYC)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Systems Lead at Replit, you'll build and own the systems that let support scale as fast as the product does. You'll own the tools our team works in every day, the technical setup behind self-service and AI-driven support, and the infrastructure that keeps all of it current as Replit ships.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You'll shape how our support systems adapt to new products, new surfaces, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and turning ad hoc fixes into infrastructure the whole team can rely on.

You'll combine hands-on technical depth with systems thinking to keep builders moving, whether they get unblocked through self-service, an AI agent, or a person. This is an individual contributor role to start, with room to grow and build out a team as support scales.



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Configure and maintain Zendesk and the surrounding support stack, from the day-to-day workflow and automation setup to business rules and permissions, keeping it able to flex and scale as needs change.

 - Build and maintain assignment logic, queues, tagging and taxonomy, and escalation paths, keeping them running cleanly as volume and workflows change.

 - Set up and maintain support tooling, workflows, and access across internal agents, outsourced vendors, and regions, keeping the systems working for each group as the stack changes.

 - Partner with Engineering on the technical requirements for self-service and in-product support surfaces, and build the entry points, help widgets, and routing behind them.

 - Spot the repetitive steps in agent and admin workflows before they become bottlenecks, and build the automations, bulk actions, and scripts, including in Replit, that take them out.

 - Take in tooling and systems requests from across support, run tool and vendor evaluations for the support stack, and lead a migration if we change platforms.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years in support operations, support systems, tooling, or a similar technical operations role.

 - Hands-on administration of a ticketing platform like Zendesk: building triggers and automations, macros, views, and SLAs, and managing routing, groups, and permissions.

 - Experience building and maintaining integrations across SaaS tools using APIs and webhooks.

 - Comfortable troubleshooting directly and working with engineers on more complex system needs.

 - Strong judgment about prioritization in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments.

 - Comfort taking on cross-functional problems, including ones that sit between support, tooling, and engineering



NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Scripting with Python or similar to build automations, bulk actions, and internal tooling.

 - Experience standing up self-service or in-product support surfaces.

 - Experience making systems work across both BPO and in-house teams.

 - Zendesk certification.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC office. This role has an in-office requirement.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Kom og bliv en del af Danmarks førende krisecenter  Krisecenter Guldborgsund søger en erfaren socialrådgiver til en fast stilling
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at gøre en reel forskel for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer?

Kan du kombinere høj socialfaglighed med empati, struktur og handlekraft, og trives du i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

På Krisecenter Guldborgsund arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe sikkerhed, nye handlemuligheder og en vej videre for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer. Vi er et hus i rivende udvikling, og vi har høje ambitioner, både på vores beboeres og vores fagligheds vegne.

Hvem er vi?

Krisecenter Guldborgsund har 21 lejligheder med plads til voksne og op mod 30 medfølgende børn, og sommetider også familiens kæledyr.

Fælles for vores beboere er, at de har været udsat for vold i nære relationer og derfor har søgt ophold hos os.

Vi er et stort hus, hvor der sker meget i løbet af en dag. Det kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket, være fleksibel og samtidig holde fast i struktur, faglighed og dokumentation.

Hos os arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi tror på, at den bedste indsats skabes, når forskellige perspektiver bringes i spil.

Din rolle som rådgiver

Som rådgiver får du en central rolle i den enkelte borgers ophold og forløb på krisecenteret.

Arbejdet spænder fra den første visitation og vurdering af sikkerhedsbehov til samtaler, risikovurderinger, koordinering, myndighedssamarbejde og støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse efter volden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Åben rådgivning til borgere, som ikke er indskrevet på krisecenteret.

  • Visitationssamtaler og vurdering af indskrivningsgrundlag og sikkerhedsbehov.

  • Udarbejdelse og løbende opfølgning på risikovurderinger og relevante sikkerhedstiltag.

  • Ugentlige samtaler med de borgere, du er kontaktperson for.

  • Rådgivning og vejledning omkring blandt andet bolig, økonomi, sociale ydelser, bopæl og forældremyndighed.

  • Koordinering af borgernes sager på tværs af myndigheder og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Handleplansmøder med borgere og betalingskommuner.

  • Udarbejdelse af opholdsplaner

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde omkring både voksne og medfølgende børn.

  • Journalføring, notatpligt og øvrig relevant socialfaglig dokumentation.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger først og fremmest en erfaren socialrådgiver, som hviler i sin faglighed og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver

  • Har minimum 5 års relevant erhvervserfaring.

  • Har solid socialfaglig erfaring og gerne erfaring med udsatte borgere, vold i nære relationer, myndighedsarbejde, familieområdet eller lignende.

  • Er stærk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Kan skabe en professionel og tillidsfuld relation til mennesker, der befinder sig i en krisesituation.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket, også når planerne pludselig ændrer sig.

  • Forstår betydningen af grundig og rettidig dokumentation.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig ser tværfagligt samarbejde som en naturlig del af arbejdet.

  • Har mod på at være en aktiv del af huset og beboernes hverdag , vi er et krisecenter, ikke kun en kontorarbejdsplads.

Vi lægger vægt på faglighed og erfaring, men også på hvem du er som menneske. Vi bruger mange timer sammen, og derfor betyder humor, engagement, fleksibilitet og lysten til at bidrage til fællesskabet også noget for os.

Team og organisering

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er kendetegnet ved et tæt og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et team bestående af leder, faglig koordinator, socialrådgivere, pædagoger, psykoterapeut, psykolog, administrativ medarbejder, pedel og rengøringspersonale.

Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af faggrupper og forventer, at alle bidrager til huset og den fælles opgave.

Arbejdstid

Rådgivernes arbejdstid er som udgangspunkt placeret i dagtimerne, typisk kl. 8.00-15.00 og enkelte dage kl. 8.00-16.00.

I denne stilling vil onsdag være den faste ugentlige lange arbejdsdag med arbejdstid frem til kl. 18.00.

Du bestemmer selv om du ønsker 30, 32 eller 37 timer ugentligt.

Derudover indgår rådgiverne i:

  • Weekendvagt hver 8. weekend, lørdag og søndag kl. 10.00-16.00.

  • Helligdagsvagter, typisk 1-2 vagter afhængigt af de pågældende helligdage.

Personalegruppen planlægger i høj grad selv fordelingen af sommerferie og helligdagsvagter. Det fungerer rigtig godt i praksis, og medarbejderne er gode til at koordinere indbyrdes og tage hensyn til både hinandens ønsker og krisecenterets behov for bemanding.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på en arbejdsplads, hvor dit arbejde har reel betydning for mennesker i en vanskelig livssituation.

  • Et stærkt og engageret tværfagligt miljø.

  • En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og plads til udvikling.

  • En hverdag med både selvstændighed, ansvar og mulighed for faglig sparring.

  • En organisation i udvikling, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed, samarbejde, humor og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Og ikke mindst: de bedste og sjoveste kollegaer – en god blanding af både mænd og kvinder.

Ansættelse

Stillingen er en fast stilling med ansættelse fra 1/11-2026

Ansøgning samt CV sendes til linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. septmber 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt: 24. septmeber 2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Linda Møllgren
Leder, Krisecenter Guldborgsund
Telefon: 51 93 07 82 mellem kl. 11.00-14.00
Mail: linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Vi søger ikke bare en socialrådgiver, der kan løse en række opgaver. Vi søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores hus, vores faglige udvikling og den forskel, vi hver eneste dag forsøger at skabe for mennesker udsat for vold i nære relationer.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation is open for appointment from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter. The position is available for a period of 20 months and is based at Aalborg University’s campus in Aalborg.

You will be part of the research group Batteries, which is placed in the section for Mechatronic Systems. The position is closely connected to our activities within applied battery research, and your work will contribute to the development of new knowledge within this field.

Your work tasks
In this position you will conduct research within battery state estimation, with a particular focus on emerging sodium-ion battery technology. You will be involved in both independent and collaborative research activities in close interaction with colleagues in the group and external partners in Denmark and abroad.

You will work with the design and execution of research studies, the analysis and interpretation of data, and the dissemination of results in high-quality scientific outlets. Your daily work will typically involve a combination of independent research and collaboration in project teams, where you help develop concepts, methods and solutions that are relevant for the energy sector.

In particular, you will be involved in a research project related to development of a battery management system (BMS) tailored for sodium-ion batteries. The tasks include battery cell characterization and modelling based on laboratory tests, and development of algorithms for estimating the charge level, health, and power capability which includes robustness against different operation conditions. The position is a part of a research project and prototype battery modules will be produced by one of the partners. The tasks include testing of these prototype modules as well. Sodium-ion batteries is a relatively new technology, and they have their own electrochemical properties. One of the key questions of this research project is to obtain a better understanding of the difference between emerging sodium-ion batteries and traditional lithium-ion based batteries when it comes to the battery state estimation and management.

You will be expected to contribute to scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals and to present your work at conferences, workshops and meetings with partners. You will collaborate with researchers across the department and, where relevant, with industrial or public stakeholders. jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Thermal Engineering with a Focus on Electronics Cooling in Early Component Design
jobs.description:
Fixed-term full-time position (4 years), to be filled from 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter, at the Aalborg campus.

If you want to contribute to the next generation of high-power electronic components by integrating thermal design directly into the early stages of technology and component development, this position may be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for an Assistant Professor for the Section for Thermal Engineering who can strengthen and further develop our activities within electronics cooling, thermal-fluid modelling, and the integration of thermal design considerations into the early development of future technologies. The position includes research, teaching, and collaboration with both internal and external partners, and you will play an active role in shaping new projects together with colleagues in power electronics. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to joint research projects and external funding applications that bridge thermal engineering and power electronics in the design of future power modules.

Your work tasks
As an Assistant Professor in the Section for Thermal Engineering, you will join a strong academic environment where research, teaching, and collaboration with external partners are closely linked. The position is based at the Aalborg campus, and you will be part of an international department working within thermal energy systems, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and related areas. In this position, you will work in close collaboration with researchers in power electronics, in particular Associate Professor Stig Munk Nielsen and colleagues in the power electronics and devices environment. Together, you will contribute to the co-design of new power modules where thermal, electrical, and mechanical aspects are considered on equal footing from the earliest design stages.

Your primary research task will be to develop and carry out research in electronics cooling and thermal-fluid design methods, with a particular focus on supporting decision-making in the early stages of technology and component development. This includes thermal-fluid co-design of devices such as IGBTs, MOSFETs, power modules, and other switching devices, where cooling concepts are integrated as explicit design parameters alongside electrical and electromagnetic performance. You will analyse trade-offs between thermal resistance, temperature gradients, power density, lifetime, and reliability, and contribute to the development of thermal and fluid-dynamic models that can be used early in the development process for screening and optimisation before detailed designs are fixed.

Depending on your background, you may initially focus more strongly on modelling, experiments, or design methodology, and gradually expand your activities towards broader thermal-fluid co-design research.

A central part of your work will be to explore and assess advanced cooling concepts for high-power-density systems. This may include integrated cooling solutions, direct-liquid cooling, and two-phase cooling for very high heat fluxes. You will develop and use Computational Fluid Dynamics models in combination with analytical and reduced-order models, and contribute to publishing research results in international journals and conferences. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to the development of joint research activities and external funding applications together with colleagues from thermal engineering and power electronics.

In parallel with the modelling activities, you will contribute to experimental work at component and module level. This can include development and use of experimental setups for characterisation of thermal resistances and heat fluxes, and validation of cooling concepts at chip, module, and package level. You will work with the interplay between experiments, CFD, and reduced-order models to develop design tools that are sufficiently fast for iterative early-stage development while still capturing the relevant physics.

In teaching, you will contribute to bachelor’s and master’s level courses within thermal engineering, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and thermal systems. You will help develop exercises and project activities that draw on realistic engineering problems and demonstrate the interaction between electrical loading, losses, and cooling solutions. You will supervise project and thesis students working on thermal design, cooling concepts, modelling, and experimental investigations. Over time, you are expected to develop a coherent teaching profile linked closely to your research activities and collaborations.

In addition, you will contribute to shared tasks within the section and department, including industry collaboration, study programme development, and supervision of projects associated with externally funded activities.

Your competencies
You have a solid academic background within Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related field, and you hold a PhD degree that qualifies you to work independently with research and research-based teaching.

We recognise that strong candidates may not fulfil every aspect of the profile. Applicants with a strong background in thermal engineering, thermal-fluid modelling, simulation-driven design, or technology development are encouraged to apply, provided they are motivated to further develop competences in electronics cooling and interdisciplinary research.

It is essential that you can document strong competences in flow simulations and thermal modelling, including model development. You have experience using Computational Fluid Dynamics and thermal models as tools to support design and development decisions, rather than solely as post-design analysis tools. You are comfortable working with software environments such as Ansys and OpenFOAM and are motivated to further develop and apply these tools in the context of advanced thermal systems and electronic components.

Prior experience within electronics cooling, component design, thermal management, or related technology development activities will be considered an advantage, but applicants from adjacent fields with strong thermal-fluid competences are also encouraged to apply. Experience from research and development activities, either in academia or industry, including participation in technology development projects and collaboration across disciplines, will likewise be considered an advantage.

Experience with experimental methods in thermal and fluid mechanics, including data analysis, uncertainty estimation, and model validation, is desirable. Familiarity with optical measurement techniques in fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be particularly relevant, as you may contribute to laboratory teaching and research activities.

You are able to reason across scales, from components to systems, and you understand when models must be highly detailed and when lightweight approaches are needed to support efficient development processes.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and orally, and are willing to engage with students, colleagues, and external partners in an international environment. Since part of the teaching and industrial collaboration takes place in Danish, you are expected to be able to supervise students in Danish within two years of employment.

As a colleague, you are motivated by interdisciplinary collaboration and enjoy working at the interface between different engineering disciplines, where modelling, experiments, and design considerations must be integrated to develop effective solutions. You bring strong analytical skills, an interest in both modelling and experiments, and a collaborative mindset. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and contribute positively to the academic environment.

jobs.description:

English at Pembroke is taught by a large, dynamic team across Years 7 to 12, spanning both SACE and the International Baccalaureate. Our Middle School curriculum has been recently redesigned around conceptual threads and a portfolio-based approach to assessment that prioritises the process of learning, not just its products. Our teachers enjoy considerable freedom in text selection, within a framework of high academic expectations, and our faculty culture is one of collegiality, intellectual curiosity and serious engagement with pedagogy. Our staff contribute to curriculum design, and are supported to grow as practitioners at every career stage.


About the Role

Successful applicants will teach across the secondary years, with allocations shaped by experience and strengths. Depending on the appointment, this may include Middle School classes, senior SACE English subjects, or IB Diploma Language A courses.


Key Responsibilities include:

  • Delivering engaging, rigorous and innovative English lessons that foster a love of learning
  • Supporting students to develop strong literacy, analytical and communication skills
  • Providing purposeful assessment and feedback that supports every students' growth
  • Contributing to a positive and collaborative culture across the Middle and Senior Schools
  • Actively participating in the life of the School through co-curricular and pastoral care contributions.


About You

You are an effective teacher first and foremost, with demonstrated impact on student learning and a command of your subject that lets you teach with both rigour and imagination.


You will bring:

  • Strong subject knowledge and a love of literature and language that students can feel
  • Evidence-informed, responsive pedagogy and high expectations of every learner
  • Capacity or willingness to teach across SACE and IB pathways (IB experience is valued but not required; training and support are provided)
  • Strong communication with students, families and colleagues
  • A collaborative disposition and a genuine interest in contributing to faculty and school life


Applications at All Career Stages

We welcome applications from experienced practitioners and from graduate and early-career teachers alike. Early-career appointees are supported through structured mentoring and induction as part of a faculty that takes professional growth seriously.


Required for Employment (Prior to Commencement)

  • Current Working with Children Check (South Australia)
  • Current Plink RRHAN-EC training: Masterclass and Fundamentals, including Protective Practices
  • First Aid and CPR

With opportunities for professional growth, a strong sense of belonging, and a genuine appreciation for staff, Pembroke is a place where your work is seen, valued, and celebrated.


Read more in The Heart of Pembroke - Celebrating our Staff.


Pembroke School is a co-educational, non-denominational, day and boarding School from Early Learning Centre to Year 12. Renowned for academic excellence and a broad, inclusive program, Pembroke offers the South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE) and is also an International Baccalaureate World School, offering the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) and Primary Years Programme (PYP).


Pembroke is a vibrant and exciting School catering for a diverse community of students. With over 1,700 students, the School offers a broad-ranging curriculum and an outstanding choice of co-curricular opportunities. The School employs over 300 permanent and fixed-term staff, plus more than 150 casual employees.


Pembroke seeks to engage outstanding, diverse and well-qualified staff to work in our welcoming and open School. All staff work together to provide an environment that facilitates each studentâs exploration of their potential, academic progress and personal welfare. Staff are encouraged to maintain a collaborative approach, a broad outlook within their respective field and a commitment to ongoing professional development and continuous improvement. Pembroke is a lively and fulfilling place to work.


How to Apply

Applications for this position close on Sunday, 6 September 2026, at 11:59 pm.


  • You are required to upload a CV and a cover letter (maximum 2 pages) identifying your interest in applying and what you could bring to the role.
  • Your application should be addressed to the Acting Principal, Mr Chris Zielinski.
  • The School reserves the right to shortlist and interview candidates before the closing date. Early applications are strongly encouraged.
  • For any enquiries regarding this position, please email talent@pembroke.sa.edu.au
  • Please do not email your applications.
  • Late applications and those submitted via external recruitment agencies will not be considered.

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto:

Operater u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda

(broj izvršitelja 4)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Minimalna razina obrazovanja: SSS

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: 2 smjene – prijepodne/poslijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 3 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima

Vozačka dozvola: B kategorija

Plaća: 1.304,83 € do 1.500,60 € bruto

Opis posla:

  • održavanje opreme, uređaja, građevina i okoliša u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda
  • rukovanje s repromaterijalima i kemikalijama koje se koriste u procesu pročišćavanja otpadnih voda,
  • dehidriranje otpadnog mulja,
  • nadopuna spremnika za kemikalije prema radnim postupcima,
  • skidanje korozije po opremi i zaštita odgovarajućim sredstvima,
  • pomaganje kod redovitih remonta i popravaka opreme i crpki,
  • održavanje alata,
  • održavanje travnjaka,
  • rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručno ili daljinskim upravljanjem, pokretanje i zaustavljanje rada crpki i opreme koja se koristi u tehnološkom postupka pročišćavanja otpadnih voda,
  • obavljanje rutinskih poslova na održavanju opreme (pranje grubih i finih rešetki, zgrtača, mjerne opreme, bazena, izlaznih brana, skidanje korozije, zaštita opreme odgovarajućim zaštitnim sredstvima..),
  • kontrola ispunjenosti kontejnera za otpad i po potrebi zamjena beskonačnih vreća za otpad,
  • pomoć oko čišćenja kod pražnjenja mastolova, zamjena hvatača masti i ulja…,
  • čišćenje građevina postrojenja i prihvata septika,
  • obrada i dehidracija mulja, održavanje kontejnera za mulj čistim,
  • mjerenje koncentracije plinova prema radnim uputama,

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme (preslik svjedodžbe/diplome);
  3. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije
  4. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (e radna knjižica);

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar (pisarnica) ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Operater u Službi pročišćavanja otpadnih voda „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/ i Grada Zadra.

jobs.title: Ship mechanic
jobs.description:
Marine turbine repair mechanic

Work tasks: Job duties: • Diagnostics of the technical condition of ship turbines. • Repair, dismantling, assembly and adjustment of turbine equipment. • Carrying out planned maintenance and emergency repairs. • Quality control of work and testing of equipment after repairs. • Work with technical documentation, drawings and diagrams. • Identification of causes of failures and their elimination. • Compliance with occupational and industrial safety requirements.

We offer: For our part, we offer work in the territory of a ship repair yard in Tallinn, stable and competitive wages, opportunities for professional development and improving qualifications. We provide work clothes and personal protective equipment.

Other requirements: • Secondary or higher education in a technical field (marine mechanics, mechanical engineering, etc.).
• At least 2–3 years of work experience with turbine equipment (preferably on ships). • Knowledge of the operating principles of turbines, pumps, reducers and auxiliary systems. • Ability to read technical drawings and diagrams. • Ability to use measuring instruments. • Conscientiousness, accuracy and teamwork skills. An advantage is: • Previous work experience in ship repair or maritime.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Sagsbehandlende ergoterapeut eller fysioterapeut til Hjælpemiddelafdelingen 37 timer/uge (Barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Sagsbehandler med blik for hele mennesket til Hjælpemiddelafdelingen

Tryg i lovgivningen – modig i mødet.

Vores kollega skal på barsel og derfor søger vi en barselsvikar.

Du er tryg i lovgivningen, og du har evnen til at se hele mennesket og skabe muligheder i fællesskab.

I Hjælpemiddelafdelingen i Kolding Kommune arbejder vi med en helhedsorienteret tilgang og skaber meningsfulde forløb sammen med borgerne. Vores vision 'Selvværd og Sammenhæng' er vores fælles kompas: Vi stiller spørgsmål, før vi giver svar – og vi skaber løsninger sammen med borgeren.

Om stillingen

Stillingen har fokus på hjælpemidler og boligændringer

Som en del af vores afdeling får du ansvar for hele processen omkring ansøgning, afgørelser og opfølgning – altid i tæt dialog med borgere, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere. Vi arbejder systemisk, nysgerrigt og helhedsorienteret. Hos os er du ikke bare sagsbehandler – du er med til at udvikle løsninger, der giver mening for borgerne.

Vi er ca. 30 medarbejdere med en faglig leder og en afdelingschef.
 

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • er uddannet ergoterapeut eller fysioterapeut

  • har solid erfaring med sagsbehandling og et stærkt fagligt fundament

  • tør udfordre vaner og finde nye løsninger sammen med borgeren

  • kan balancere relation og faglighed, og bringer professionel empati ind i dit arbejde

  • trives med både korte og lange sagsforløb og kan navigere i kompleksitet

  • arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt – og samtidig bidrager til fællesskabet

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • en arbejdsplads, hvor du kan udvikle og styrke gode forløb med borgerne

  • en arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor du er med til at forme både løsninger og arbejdskultur

  • at du bliver en del af et stærkt Myndighedsteam på hjælpemiddelområdet, med et fagligt miljø hvor sparring, læring og udvikling prioriteres

  • en ledelse, der tror på tillid, tydelighed og åben dialog

  • fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar i et barselsvikariat på 37 timer

Om Kolding Kommune

Hjælpemiddelafdelingen er organiseret i Senior-, Sundheds- og Fritidsforvaltningen, hvor vi arbejder ud fra en fælles tilgang 'Selvværd og Sammenhæng'. Derfor skal du også være i stand til at se dig selv indarbejde elementerne fra 'Selvværd og Sammenhæng' naturligt i dine arbejdsgange.

Vi ser borgeren som et helt menneske. Derfor stiller vi spørgsmål, frem for at give svar – og vi finder de gode løsninger sammen med borgeren. Og fordi vi bruger vores faglighed og samarbejder på tværs, kan vi skabe de bedste rammer for borgerens liv.

Find mere information om levereglerne og en hel masse mere om Selvværd og Sammenhæng på vores hjemmeside www.selvvaerdogsammenhaeng.dk.
 

Interesseret?

For at høre mere om stillingen er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os.

Afdelingschef Bettina Mumm på telefon 51 29 96 79 eller via mail befi@kolding.dk

Faglig leder Linda Luxhøi på telefon 40 38 90 53 eller via mail lilux@kolding.dk
 

Løn:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter principperne om lokal løndannelse.
 

Arbejdssted: Hjælpemiddelafdelingen Ålegården 2-4, 6000 Kolding.  

Arbejdstid: 37 timer ugentligt

Ansættelsesvilkår: Barselsvikariat pr. 1. november 2026

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 17. september 2026

Der udsendes indkaldelse til samtaler d. 17. september 2026

Samtaler afholdes d. 24. september 2026
 

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk via knappen ”Søg stilling” under stillingsannoncen. Vedhæft venligst dokumentation for uddannelse.
 

Forud for ansættelse indhenter Kolding Kommune straffeattest/børneattest, når loven kræver det, eller stillingen i øvrigt berettiger til det.

Alle stillinger er fuldtidsstillinger medmindre andet er angivet. Kolding Kommune opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion og etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen. Forud for ansættelse indhenter Kolding Kommune straffeattest/børneattest, når loven kræver det, eller stillingen i øvrigt berettiger til det.  

Overvejer du at flytte til Kolding Kommune? Læs mere om mulighederne for at bo og leve i Kolding Kommune på www.komtilkolding.dk

jobs.title: Afdelingsleder Solmarken
jobs.description:
Sæt dit præg på Solmarken som afdelingsleder fra d. 1.11.2026

  • Vil du være på fornavn med 60 skønne børn og sætte retningen for børnehaven sammen med et stærkt ledelsesteam?

  • Vil du indgå i et fagligt fællesskab i en integreret institution med et tæt forældresamarbejde?

  • Vil du være med til at udfordre både i dig selv og 16 dygtige kolleger, hvor vi sammen får styrket vores pædagogiske fundament?

  • Har du stærke relationskompetencer og er systematisk, og ser du organisering og struktur som et værdifuldt pædagogisk redskab?

  • Og kan du omsætte aftalte pædagogiske indsatser, og følge op på dem i den daglige praksis?

  • Så glæder vi os til at få dig med på holdet som vores nye afdelingsleder i Solmarken.

Indgå i ledelsen og skab tæt samarbejder med engageret forældre og tværfaglige teams

Solmarken er et selvejende dagtilbud, med plads til 100 børn fordelt i vuggestue og børnehave. Tidligere havde vi særlige formålspladser, nu ehar vi social normering.

I denne stilling kommer du til at indgå i et ledelsesteam, som består af en souschef og en leder. Sammen med os er du med til at gå foran, ved siden af og lige bagved i de opgaver vi har fokus på. Her er masser af pædagogiske udfordringer og spændende opgaver.

Samtidig vil din hverdag være præget af:

  • Tværfaglige indsatser, almene og specialpædagogiske opgaver i samarbejde med PPR, sprogkonsulent, ressourcekonsulent og socialrådgiver.

  • God kommunikation og tæt samarbejde med kolleger og forældre

  • Faglige tiltag, der udvikler dine kolleger fagligt i mødet med børnene

  • Fokus på at skabe trygge læringsmiljøer ved at skabe struktur, rutiner og genkendelighed

  • Deltagelse og facilitering af personalemøder med faglig dialog, tjek-ind og pædagogiske temaer.

Skab og udvikle på en tæt relation til hvert barn, imens du møder dem i børnehøjde

I Solmarken har vi fokus på børnenes trivsel, sociale og sproglige kompetencer. Vi tager afsæt i COS, tryghedscirklen og ICDP. Vi ser det som særligt værdifuldt, at være med til at skabe en hverdag med pædagogik der styrker legekulturen, de gode og sunde fælleskaber.

Sæt dig præg på børnelivet i Frederiksberg kommune

Vores personalegruppe rummer alle aldre og ancienniteter og vi har helt sikkert også plads til dig. Send os din ansøgning med relevante bilag til: solmarken@frederiksberg.dk

For yderligere information er du velkommen til at kontakteleder Karin Meyer på 28 44 91 00 eller souschef Pernille på 28 44 91 01. Solmarkens hovednummer er: 36 30 37 40.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst med BUPL. Startløn som afdelingsleder i Frederiksberg kommune ligger på løntrin 30.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 10.9.2026 kl 12.00

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes af holdes d. 16.9.2026 fra kl 15.00.

Vi ønsker kun at modtage ansøgninger med uddannelsesbevis og CV fra uddannet pædagoger.

jobs.title: Senior Level Designer
jobs.description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year
\n

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.



This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.



You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.



The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $165,000 - $205,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
